tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs bzhugs//

"$ ༄༅// bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// thog mar nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral nas spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du mngon par rtogs pa bsgom snyam du bsams la/ rang nyid zhal cig phyag gnyis pa'i spyan ras gzigs dmar po g.yas 'phreng ba/ g.yon pad ma/ thugs khar hriḥdamar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa bltas la/ 'od zer las rta mgrin zhal cig phyag gnyis pa'i tshogs dang*/ me dang mtshon cha'i tshogs spros te/ bgegs thams cad tshar bcad par bsam mo// de nas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang*/ rdo rje'i ra ba dang*/ gur khang du byin gyis brlab bo// yang rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer spro bas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang bla ma yi dam rnams mngon par bltas te/ mchod cing phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag go /de nas oṃ swa bha ba shud dho sarba dharmā sa bha ba shud dho haṃ zhes de dag thams cad bsdus te chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom par bya'o// de ni ye shes kyi tshogs so// de nas stong pa'i ngang las rang gi rnam par shes pa yi ge hriḥdamar po las/ 'og phyogs su 'od zer las gyur pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams pad ma ra ga las grub pa'i chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du pad ma'i sdong po/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥde tsheg drag dang bcas pa las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas sems can thams cad dang phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'od du zhu nas/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ zhes brjod pa tsam gyis sems can thams cad thugs rje chen por gyur par bsgom zhing*/ 'od zer tshur 'dus rang la thim pas/ rang nyid jo bo thugs rje chen po sku mdog shin tu dmar po zhal cig phyag bzhi pa/

phyag dang po gnyis thugs khar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi 'og ma na mu tig gi 'phreng ba dmar po 'dren pa/ g.yon gyi 'og ma na me tog pad ma'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs dkyil mo dkrung gis bzhugs pa/ sku la rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du bcings pa la/ dar gyi cod pan dang rin po che'i rtse bran rnam pa lnga yis brgyan pa/ g.yas phyogs na dpal rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po/ phyag g.yas na ḍa ma ru/ g.yon na dril bu bsnams pa/ rta skad 'tsher zhing gar byed pa tsam gyis dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor bar bsam zhing*/ g.yon phyogs na gsang ba ye shes kyi ḍa ki ma sku mdog dmar ba/ zhal cig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lnga yis brgyan pa/ a ra li'i sgra sgrogs shing gar thabs mdzad pa tsam gyi/ ḍa ki rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor bar bsgom zhing*/ snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdud pa dang*/ byin gyis rlobs par bsgom mo// spyi gtsug tu gu ru pad ma 'byung gnas sku mdog nag po/ gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ a tsa ra'i cha byad can/ rus pa'i rgyan cha drug gis brgyan pa/ snang srid zil gyis gnon pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ gar thabs mdzad pa'i tshul gyis pad ma zla ba nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ bka' brgyud kyi bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang*/ slob dpon pad ma'i ngo bor steng gi nam mkha' la khrigs kyis gang bar bzhugs pa ni/ steng bla ma bka' rgyud bsgom pa'i rim pa'o/ rang gi gdan gyi zhabs su ye shes pa dang 'jig rten pa'i chos skyong ba'i bsrungs ma rnams dang*/ 'gro drug gi sems can rnams kyang rigs bzhi ḍa ki ma'i ngo bor gyur nas/ rang gi gdan bteg pa dang*/ snang srid dbang du bsdud pa dang*/ bka' nyan gsung bsdod kyi tshul du bsgom pa ni/ 'og bka' nyan gsung bsdod bsrungs ma'i dkyil 'khor ro// de nas sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa ni/

spyi bor zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad ma'i steng du a dmar po/ thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po dang hrīḥdamar po bsgom pa'o// de nas rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥ las 'od zer dmar po 'phros pas rang gi bskyed pa lta bu'i rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la yan lag bdun pa rgyas par byas shing*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho byas pa tsam gyis rang la thim par bsgom pa ni ye shes kyi 'khor lo gzhug pa'o// de nas dbang bskur ba ni/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo gsal bar dmigs la/ bdag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes brjod pas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rin po che'i bum pa thogs pas/ spyi bo nas dbang bskur zhing*/ ngag tu/ spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// sangs rgyas rnams kyi bum pa'i dbang*// rgyal sras rnams la bskur ba ltar// do nub khyod la bskur bar bya// chos dbyings ye shes dbang 'di khyod kyis long*// zhes bya bas dbang bskur te/ snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par bya'o// de ltar sgyu ma ltar yun ring du goms par bya zhing*/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ thugs ka'i hriḥlas snying pos g.yas bskor du bsgoms pa las 'od zer 'phros te/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs bsdus pa'i tshul du bzlas pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hriḥ.oṃ ma ṇi pad ma hūm̐/ dhu ma gha ye na ma/ ha ri ni sa/ rā dza hrīḥya hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes bzla bar bya'o// de nas bzlas pa la skyo na rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom par bya ba ni/ lha thams cad bdag nyid la bsdus te yang hrī la bsdus nas khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can rnams kyis phung po khams dang skye mched rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs dang*/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa/

skye ba med pa 'gag pa med pa/ rang sems mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang du bsgom du ci yang med pa/ 'khrul pa med pa/ g.yeng ba med pa'i don la rgyun du gnas par bya'o/ 'di la goms na mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bskyed rdzogs bsdus pa 'di// gzhung dang 'jigs byed chen mo 'thor ba rnams// phyogs cig rang byung rdo rjes bsdus pa la// 'gal dang nor 'khrul chad lhag gyur pa rnams// bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol// rdzogs so// bkra shis dpa' 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog/ ༈ //bcom ldan pad ma zab pa'i mngon rtogs tshig lhug ma bzhugs so// bcom ldan 'das pad ma'i snang ba chen po rab tu rgyas pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rab 'byams chos kyi dbyings la bde ba can// dbang chen rol pa pad ma'i gsung gi bdag /'jig rten 'dren pa rmad byung spyan ras gzigs// rgyal ba thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal 'dud// de la 'dir re shig bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba rgya mtsho pad ma zab pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par 'dod pas don gsum ste/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la bzhi las/ thog mar dkyil 'khor 'di ru dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa dang snying rje chen po dang ldan pas/ dben pa'i gnas su rdzas dang dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba dbang mchog ltar shes par bya'o// gnyis pa bdag nyid stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral nas/ spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du mngon par rtogs pa bsgom snyam du byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bya'o// gsum pa rang nyid spyan ras gzigs dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas pad ma g.yon 'phreng ba can gyi thugs khar hrīḥdamar po tsheg drag can bltas la/ 'od zer las rta mgrin zhal cig phyag gnyis pa'i tshogs dang*/

me ri dang mtshon cha'i tshogs spros te/ bgegs thams cad tshar gcad par bsam/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ bar rdo rje'i ra ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur khang du byin gyis brlab par bya'o// bzhi pa rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo 'og nas 'chad par bltas la/ yan lag bdun pa rgyas pas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag go /de nas sems can thams cad la byams pa dang snying rje dang dga' ba dang btang snyoms te tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgoms nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi lha tshogs thams cad bdag nyid la bsdus te/ oṃ swa bha ba shud dho sarba dharmā swa bha ba shud dho haṃ/ zhes pas chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgoms te sngon du 'gro ba'o// dngos gzhi la gnyis te/ bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// thog ma la bdun las dang po ni stong pa nyid kyi ngang las rang gi rnam par shes pa yi ge hrīḥdamar po ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin 'od kha dog lnga 'phro ba'i 'od zer 'og gi phyogs su 'phros pas/ 'od zer las gyur pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams pad ma ra ga las grub pa chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa/ de'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje yangs shing rgya che ba'i lte bar byang chub gyi shing snying po rgyan yid du 'ong ba 'bras bu dang lo ma thams cad nor bu rin po che dang bkra shis rdzas brgyad du grub pa/ de'i steng du paṃ las pad ma rgyas pa chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa ste/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing sbyong ba'o// gnyis pa rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni/ pad ma'i lte bar bhrum̐ las gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa ka ba brgyad kyis yang dag par mdzes pa/ dbus su zlum bskor gtso bo'i 'dom gang ba/ de'i nam mkha' la rgya gram gyi gdung gi mthar rin po che'i gdung zlum po rgya gram gyi khong seng du zug pa/

de'i mthar rdo rje'i gdung zlum mo// de'i mthar 'khor lo'i gdung zlum po/ de'i mthar phyogs bzhir gyes pa las rgya gram gyi gdung bzhi pa phyir lhag pa dang de nyid kyis mtshan pa ste/ thog gi dbyibs so// phyi'i dbyibs logs re re la gtso bo'i 'dom brgyad dang ldan pa/ ye shes lnga'i brdar pan tsa ra ga'i brtsigs pa lnga nang nas rim pa ltar dmar po sngon po ser po dkar po ljang gu ste/ pad ma ra ga dang*/ bai ḍurya dang*/ gser dang*/ shel dang*/ in tra ni las grub pa zheng du khru lnga 'phangs su 'dom gsum pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu khru gang ba'i steng du rin po che'i bai ḍurya'i snam bu 'dom gang ba/ de'i steng du ba so'i gseng khang khru gang ba'i bar bar rnams su rin po che bre la tsi pa tra'i kha nas byung ba'i drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du gdung gi sna la rdo rje rgya gram gyis mtshan pa/ phyir la 'dom phyed lhag pa'i tshul gyis 'dod yon snam bu dang mnyam pa steng du rdo skar ma shi sha las grub pa'i rtsa brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ sgo bzhi glo 'bur gyi tshul du gnas pa la ka ba bzhis bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs cha bzhi'i tshul du mdzes pa/ gtso bo'i tog gi rdo rje rgya gram gyi steng du chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa bcu gsum dang ldan pa la gdugs char khebs dar dpyangs kyis spras pa/ rta babs re re'i steng du yang chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa bcu gsum pa/ phyogs bzhi na ri dwags bzhi bzhi/ mtshams na ba dan bzhi bzhi bcu gnyis la ba dan bcu gnyis kyis brgyan pa'o// de'i phyi rol du 'dod yon gyi snam bu zur bcu gnyis dang ldan pa 'khor ba/ de'i phyi rol du chus bcad pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de'i phyi rol du rdo rje ra ba gur khang me ri dang bcas pa blta'o// de'i dbus na sna tshogs pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'o// gsum pa brten pa lha'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i rim pa ni/

pad nyi'i steng du hrīḥbab pa las 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mchod/ sems can la phog sdig sgrib dag nas 'od du zhu ste/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐ zhes brjod pas sems can thams cad thugs rje chen por gyur par bsgom zhing*/ yang*/ oṃ a hūm̐ hrī/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐ zhes brjod pas 'od zer tshur 'dus rang la thim nas yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs dmar po yab yum rdo rje phag mo dang gnyis su med par sbyor ba zhal ga cig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis yum gyi rgyab tu 'khyud pa'i tshul gyis thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi 'og ma na rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi 'og ma na pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor gtsug gyen du bcings pa la dar gyi cod pan dang rin po che'i rtse bran lngas brgyan pa zhabs dkyil mo dkrung du bzhugs pa'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar po zhal gnyis phyag gnyis ma/ phag zhal dmar mo spyi gtsug tu phyung ba/ rtsa ba'i khro zhal spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra grol ba la thod pa skam po lngas dbu rgyan zhing rlon pa lnga bcu rtsa gcig gis do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas thod khrag yab la ster ba'i tshul gyis 'khyud pa/ zhabs gnyis yab kyi rgyab nas 'khril ba'i tshul gyis dkyil mo dkrung bcas nas bzhugs pa'o// de'i phyogs bzhir pad nyi'i steng du yi ge hrī dmar po bzhi las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas mchod sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus hriḥl thim yongs su gyur pa las/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dmar po bzhi rang gi yum dang gnyis su med par sbyor ba ste/ kun kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po thams cad rang gi yum gyi rgyab tu 'khyud pa'i tshul du thal mo sbyor ba/

g.yas kyi 'og ma thams cad mu tig gi phreng ba dmar po 'dren pa/ g.yon gyi 'og ma thams cad me tog pad ma dmar po'i 'dab ma brgyad pa'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa/ sku la rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor gtsug gyen du bcings pa la dar gyi cod pan dang rin po che'i rtse bran lngas brgyan pa/ thams cad zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil mo krung du bzhugs pa'i pang na rang rang gi yum/ spyan ma dang ma ma ki dang na bza' dkar mo dang dam tshig sgrom ma ste/ rim pa bzhin du sngon mo ser mo dmar mo ljang khu ste/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ phyag dang po thams cad rang rang gi bdag po'i rgyab nas 'khyud pa'i tshul du thal mo sbyar ba/ ma ma ki ni g.yas kyi 'og ma nor bu/ sangs rgyas spyan ma 'khor lo/ na bza' dkar mo pad ma dkar po/ dam tshig sgrol ma ud pa la/ g.yon 'og ma thams cad pad ma dmar po bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyi brgyan pa/ zhabs rnams yab kyi rgyab tu 'khril ba'i tshul gyis dkyil krung bcas pa'o// shar lho'i 'tshams su rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon pad ma/ lho nub tu rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo g.yas nor bu g.yon pad ma/ nub byang mtshams su pad ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo g.yas bum pa g.yon pad ma/ byang shar du las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang khu g.yas ral gri g.yon pad ma bsnams pa/ sku la rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o// de'i phyi rol du 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la 'khod pa'i lha mo rnams ni/ gzugs rdo rje ma me long dang pad ma/ sgra rdo rje ma gling bu dang pad ma/ dri rdo rje ma spos phor dang pad ma/ ro rdo rje ma mkhar zhong dang pad ma/ reg rdo rje ma na bza' dang pad ma'o// bzhi pa sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ lha tshogs thams cad kyi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par nyi ma la a dmar po/

thugs kar pad ma la hūm̐ sngon po dang hrī dmar po dbyer med du bsgom/ de nas yab rnams kyi thugs ka'i hrī las oṃ a hūm̐ hrī/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐ gis g.yas su 'khor ba/ yum rnams kyi thugs ka'i hri oṃ badzra bha ra hi sarba bhu dha ḍa ki ni ye/ badzra bhai ro tsa na ye g.yon du 'khor ba/ rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar ha ri ni sa bsgoms par bya'o// lnga pa ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrī las 'od zer 'phros pas ji ltar bskyed pa lta bu spyan drangs la legs par mchod de/ dza hūm̐ bam̐ ho zhes pas lha tshogs gzhal yas khang pa dur khrod rdo rje ra ba me ri dang bcas pa dam tshig sems dpa' dang gnyis su med par bya'o// drug pa dbang bskur ba ni/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la ye shes kyi 'khor lo gsal bar bltas la/ bdag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes brjod pas lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rin po che'i bum pa thogs pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar bsam zhing*/ spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// sangs rgyas rnams kyi bum pa'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// chos dbyings ye shes dbang 'di khyod kyis longs/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ bhud dha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ ces pa dang*/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yi// de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta ya sa ma ye shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur zhing chu'i lhag ma yar 'khyil ba la/ gtso bo la snang ba mtha' yas/ rdo rje phag mo la rnam snang*/ phyogs kyi yab yum rnams la mi bskyod pa/ rin 'byung*/ don grub rnams kyis dbu brgyan pa'o// des sems can thams cad mchog gi yon tan thob par bsam mo// bdun pa bzlas pa la gnyis te/ dang po spro bsdu'i tshul du bzlas pa bzhi las/

byin brlabs bsdu ba'i tshul du bzla ba dang bdag gzhan gyi sdig sgrib sbyang ba la sogs 'phrin las bzhi'i tshul du bzla ba dang*/ bde ba chen po dang*/ 'gog pa'i bzlas pa'o// de thams cad la 'od zer spro bsdu bya zhing 'bum tsho bcu la sogs te mtshan ma mthong gi bar du bya'o// gnyis pa rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ bsre ba'i man ngag ltar bsgom zhing*/ rlung bzung ba ste/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'ang yin no/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa la gnyis te/ mi zab pa'i rdzogs rims ni rdo rje'i bzlas pa bzhin du shes par bya'o// zab pa'i rdzogs rims ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer 'khor 'das thams cad lha tshogs su gsal ba la 'phros/ de dag thams cad 'od du zhu ste bsrungs ba'i gur khang la thim/ de 'od du zhu nas rim pa bzhin du bdag nyid la 'dus te bdag thugs ka'i hri la bsdu/ hri yang gong bu dang na da'i gzugs las rnam par 'das nas rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin du bsgoms par bya'o// de'ang bsgom du med cing yengs su med pa/ dgag tu med cing bsgrub tu med pa ste/ spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i rang bzhin du gnas par bya'o/ 'di la goms na phyag rgya chen po mngon du byed par 'gyur ro// spyi don gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la gnyis te/ dang po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi nga rgyal gyis langs te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba sems can thams cad kyi don du bsngo bar bya'o// gnyis pa thun mtshams gtor ma ni ji skad bshad pa'i rim pa bzhin du rdzogs par bya'o// de ltar thun bzhi ru 'bad nas nyams su blangs pas rtags dang yon tan thams cad rgyud las bshad pa ltar skye bar 'gyur ro// de dag ni dkyil 'khor du bsgoms pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi rim pa shin tu gsal bar byas pa'o// gzhan yang maṇḍal bsgom pa dang*/ lus dkyil du bsgom pa ni mngon par rtogs pa tshigs bcad mar bstan zin no// de dag gis bsgrub pa byed na rdzas dang dkyil 'khor gong du bstan zin la/

mdun du yang bdag bskyed ltar bsgom zhing*/ las dang mthun pa'i 'od zer gyi spro bsdu dang sngags kyi sham bu btags la sgrub par bya'o// gtor ma mchod 'phreng las tshogs rnams gzhung du gsal bas de la blta'o// dbang mchog bdun tshigs rnams gnyis ni// kho bos bshad bzhin shes par bya// 'di sdebs nor 'khrul gyur pa gang*// bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol// 'di la 'jug rnams rim gnyis don mthong nas// tshe ga cig spyan ras gzigs kyi sa thob shog /bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba rgya mtsho pad ma zab pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi rim pa 'di ni/ bsgom par 'dod pa rnams kyis bskul nas rang byung rdo rjes glang lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu la u rgyan gyi mkhan po pad ma 'byung gnas kyi bsgrub gnas chen por bkod pa re shig rdzogs so// ༈ //rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i mchod 'bul bzhugs// thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs mchod dang dbang bskur gyi lag len 'di ltar bya'o// hūm̐ lho nub srin po'i grong khyer nas// grub thob bye ba 'bum gyi dbus// slob dpon pad ma gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// pad ma dbang gi zla gam nas// mgon po tshe dbang 'od dpag med// spyan ras gzigs dbang gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// mkha' spyod dag pa'i gzhal yas nas// mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum gyi dbus// yum cig mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// rta mchog rgyal po he ru ka /dpa' bo'i tshogs bcas gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// dag pa chos sku'i gzhal yas nas// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// mi 'gyur thugs kyi gzhal yas nas// rdo rje mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// pad ma gsung gi gzhal yas nas// pad ma mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// yon tan rgyas pa'i gzhal yas nas// rin chen mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// dbang skur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// 'phrin las grub pa'i gzhal yas nas// las kyi mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// 'jig rten dur khrod gzhal yas nas// 'jig rten mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// 'phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub tu gsol// dam tshig chen po'i gnas mchog nas// dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol// pho nya las mkhan mdzad du gsol// ces dril bu dkrol zhing dbyangs dang bcas pas spyan drangs par bya'o// rgyal ba rgya mtsho spyan ras gzigs// 'gro ba'i don du byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ pad ma ka ma ka ye swā hā/

ces pas bzhugs su gsol lo// de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni/ pad ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor du// pad ma mchog gi skur sprul pa'i/ gdug pa 'dul mdzad thod 'phreng la// gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐ thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug sku// sku mdog dmar gsal 'jig rten dbang du bsdud/ spyan gyi 'od zer 'gro la thugs rjes gzigs/ zhal nas hūm̐ sgras stong gsum chos sgra sgrogs// shangs nas ye shes rlung gis nyon mongs 'thor// snyan nas thabs dang shes rab 'dul thabs mdzad// phyag gnyis dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med sbyor// g.yas pas bgrang 'phreng byang chub lam sna 'dren// g.yon pa pad mas 'khor ba'i skyon dang bral// rin chen rgyan drug pha rol phyin drug ldan// zhabs gnyis 'gro ba'i don la mnyam par bzhugs// 'gro rnams ma lus thugs rjes dbang du bsdud// 'jig rten dbang phyug sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// dgyes par rol pa'i 'dzab bstod mchod par bzhes// dbang dang dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol// gsung gi dbang phyug snang ba mtha' yas sku// 'chi med tshe dbang mgon po 'od dpag med// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad gsung las sprul// bsgrub mchog bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis brlobs// gnyis med don gyis dngos grub bdag la stsol// pad ma dbang gi lha tshogs la// phyi yi mchod pa 'bul ba ni// rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// sems can nyon mongs bag chags sbyang slad du// sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// khams gsum gnas pa'i dri ma dag gyur cig /oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ argaṃ pu tsa me ga sa mun tra spha ra na sa ma ye hūm̐/ tshul khrims dri ldan spos mchod dam pa 'di// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs nas// sangs rgyas zhing du spos dri ngad ldan pa'i// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig

/oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ dhu pe pu tsa me ga sa mun tra spha ra na sa ma ye hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor kun du rgyal ba mnyes gyur pa'i// lha rdzas dbyibs legs me tog dam pa 'di// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis mngon sprul nas/ gzhal yas khang du sprin bzhin gtibs gyur cig /oṃ ma ṇi pad med hūm̐ /pus pe pu tsa me ga sa mun tra spha ra na sa ma ye hūm̐/ nyon mongs dug bsreg ma rig mun sel ba'i// shes rab gzi ldan dpal gyi sgron ma 'di// sprin med mkha' la nyi shar ji bzhin du// 'od zer snang bas phyogs bcur gsal gyur cig /oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ a lo ke pu tsa me ga sa mun tra spha ra na sa ma ye hūm̐/ stong gsum kun du dri dang ngad ldan pa'i// spos dang sman sbyar chu gtsang rgyal ba'i khrus// ye shes sprin dpung mkha' la thugs rje'i char rgyun gyis// mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs rnams dag gyur cig oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ ghan dhe pu tsa me ga sa mun tra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i sku la bkres pa mi mnga' yang*// 'gro ba'i don du lha rdzas bdud rtsi'i bshos*/ dag cing gtsang mar bshams te 'bul lags na// bsod nams zhing gyur rnams kyis bzhes su gsol// oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ ne pe te pu tsa me ga sa mun tra spha ra na sa ma ye hūm̐/ dril chen sil snyan rnam grol tshangs pa'i dbyangs// bsam dag ngag gis bstod de gus mchod 'bul// sa bcu rims kyis bgrod nas sangs rgyas sar// tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas chos kyi rgyal por shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ sha pa ta pu tsa me ga sa mun tra spha ra na sa ma ye hūm̐/ hūm̐ dus gsum sangs rgyas yum gcig ma// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag 'gro la gzigs// gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro ma// sku mdog dmar mo dbang gi tshul/ tshad med rnam bzhis 'gro don mdzad// rnam rtog rtsad gcod gri gug g.yas// 'gro ba dbang bsdud thod khrag g.yon// skye shi rtsad gcod ral gri g.yas// dug gsum rtsad gcod kha ṭam̐ g.yon// thabs dang shes rab brkyang bskum bzhugs// 'dod yon rang dag rus pas brgyan// gzhon nu'i cha lugs cung zad khro// thugs rje chags pas dbang du bsdud// nam mthong dran pas ye shes bskyed// thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs// dbang dang dngos grub bdag la stsol// rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma// rdo rje rigs kyi dngos grub stsol// rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma// nor dang bsod nams dngos grub stsol// padma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma// chags pa dbang bsdus dngos grub stsol// las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma// dgra bgegs tshar gcod dngos grub gsol// mkha' gsang ye shes dngos grub stsol// chos dbyings lhun grub dngos grub stsol// ma ha mu tra'i dngos grub stsol// pad ma dbang gi lha tshogs la// nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni// dug lnga rnam par dag pa yis// rigs lnga dang ni ye shes lnga// sha chen lnga yi mchod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol// 'byung ba lnga po rnam dag cing*// ma ma ki la sogs pa yi// rigs kyi yum chen 'byung ba lnga// shes rab dri med mchod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med cing*// zung 'jug bde ba chen po yi// kha dog reg bya yid 'ong ldan// zag med bde chen mchod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// dbang bzhi bskur dang rgyud bzhi smin// thun mong mchog gi dngos grub stsol// hūm̐ thugs kyi lha mchog rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal// sku mdog dmar nag dregs pas dbang du bsdud// spyan gyi 'od zer 'gro la thugs rjes gzigs// zhal gyi 'dzum tshul thugs rjes kun la snyoms// mche ba gtsigs pas skye shi rtsad nas gcod// dbu gtsugs rta mgo gzhan gyis 'gran du med// rta skad 'tsher bas khams gsum dbang du bsdud// dbang bsdud phyag rgyas skye 'gro zil gyis gnon// pad ma'i rgyal mtshan 'khor ba'i skyon dang bral// rin chen rgyan chas 'dod yon ma spangs dag

/zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum ye shes sems dpa'i tshul// dbang chen rta mchog sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// bsgrub mchog bdag la dbang bskur dngos grub stsol// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol// bsdu ba rnam bzhis 'jig rten dbang du bsdud// 'jig rten zil gnon 'phrin las dngos grub stsol// pad ma dbang gi lha tshogs la// gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni// thabs dang shes rab dbyer med cing*// yab yum spyod pa'i sbyor ba las// zag med bde ba chen po yis// ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol// pad ma rang byung me tog las// rag ta rang byung bde ba'i gnas// sha chen gsur dang bdug spos dang*/ zhun chen snang gsal sgron me rnams// dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol// lhan skyes bde ba chen po yi// dga' ba bzhi dang bde ba brgyad// zag med nyams kyis brgyan pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du// dpa' bo'i tshogs dang dpa' mo'i tshogs// gnyis med bde bar rol pa las// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i mchod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du// dpa' bo'i tshogs dang dpa' mo'i tshogs/ gnyis med bde bar rol pa las// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i mchod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol/ dbang bzhi bskur dang rgyud bzhi smin// gsang ba bla med dngos grub stsol// hūm̐ 'gro ba kun la thugs rjes mnyam par gzigs// nyi ma'i 'od zer sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// chags rab don gyis 'gro ba dbang du bsdud// rdo rje phag mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// sngags kyi las mdzad mdzes bstod mkha' 'gro'i tshul// rgya mtsho'i gling gi mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// las kyi mkha' 'gro'i bka' bsdod byin brlabs thog med 'bebs// rdo rje 'phra men sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// bstan pa'i ru 'dzin gdug pa'i dgra 'dul ma// mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// rnal 'byor 'khor skyong byin brlabs char ltar 'bebs// mkha' 'gro bzhi yi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog nas// rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro la sogs pa'i// phyi nang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la// gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal bstod/

dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// pad ma dbang gi lha tshogs la// de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni// chos sku skye ba med pa las// rang byung ye shes mchod par 'bul// dus gsum skye 'gag med pa la// snang ba sna tshogs mchod par 'bul/ phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub stsol// thabs dang shes rab dbyer med cing*// lhan skyes ye shes bde ba che// zag med bde chen mchod par 'bul/ dbang bzhi rdzogs par mdzad du gsol// dbyings dang ye shes ro mnyam zhing*// 'gag med ye shes lnga dang ldan// kun mkhyen ye shes mchod par 'bul// ngo bo nyid kyis dngos grub stsol// hūm̐ mi 'gyur bdud kyi sde bcom rdo rje'i rigs// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// re skong bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs rin chen rigs// rin chen mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ chags pa thams cad dbang sdud pad ma'i rigs// padma mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// don grub gdug pa 'dul mdzad las kyi rigs// las kyi mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// gdug pa 'dul mdzad rdo rje rigs su sprul// rdo rje ging chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'dod pa'i dngos grub 'byung bar byed pa yi// rin chen ging chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// chags rab don gyis 'gro ba dbang du bsdud// pad ma ging chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// las kyi mtha' yis bstan pa'i ru tra 'dul// las kyi ging chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// dgongs pa len pa'i pad ma 'byung gnas kyis// bdag dang mos pa'i gang zag la// byin rlabs chu bo'i rgyun bzhin phob// tshogs gzhung bzhin byin gyis brlab/ tshogs btab pa'i cho ga ni/ hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas// slob dpon pad ma dbang gi lha// rnam 'phrul mkha' 'gro sprin ltar gtibs/

'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// pad ma dbang gi zla gam nas// mgon po tshe dbang 'od dpag med/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbus na bzhengs// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// mkha' spyod dag pa'i gzhal yas nas// gsang ba ye shes ḍa ki ma// mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbus nas bzhengs// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// me dpung 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog dpal/ dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i dbus nas bzhengs// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// sa 'og sa steng sa bla yi// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyang*// 'dir spyon tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// dbang rnams bskur la byin gyis rlobs/ gnas mchog nyi shu rtsa bzhi nas// bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab du gsol// dur khrod chen po gnas brgyad nas// 'jig rten mkha' 'gro rdzu 'phrul can/ 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// pho nya las mkhan mdzad du gsol// dam tshig chen po'i gzhal yas nas// dam can rgya mtsho sku bskyod 'tshal// 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma bzhes// 'phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub tu gsol// ces tshogs btab cing 'bul bar bya'o// bshags pa dang*/ gshegs su gsol ba dang*/ bsngo ba dang*/ smon lam rnams gzhung na yod pa bzhin bya'o// dbang bskur tshogs mchod gang byas na'ang spyan 'dren la sogs pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs par bya'o// thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i mchod 'bul lag len ye shes sgron me zhes bya ba rang byung rdo rjes sbyar ba rdzogs so// ༈ //rgyal ba rgyal mtsho'i dbang chog bzhugs/ thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar byed pa la don gsum ste/

slob dpon dang*/ slob ma dang*/ cho ga'i rim pa'o// de la gsum ste/ sa'i cho ga dang*/ sta gon dang*/ dngos gzhi'o// dang po ni/ sa'i lha mo dang*/ gzhi bdag la gtor ma sbyin/ bden pa bdar/ gnang ba byin bar bsam pa tsam gyis kyang chog dkyil 'khor gzhan nas bshad pa ltar rgyas par byed na bzang*/ lha khang*/ khang bzang*/ brag gi steng*/ chu bo'i 'gram/ ba glang gi lhas rnams su sa chog byed mi dgos/ bskyed rims bsgoms pa la sngags brgya bzlas te/ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod nas lag pas sa la reg nas bdag gir bya'o// sta gon la bzhi ste/ lha dang*/ bum pa dang*/ sbyin bsreg dang*/ slob ma'o// dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dri bzang kyis chag chag btab la/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i me tog gi tshom bu byas la/ lha bskyed cing mchod pa dang bstod pa byas nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba// ston pa'i gtso bo spyan ras gzigs// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// lha rnams la ni mchod pa dang*// sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ dkyil 'khor dam pa 'bri bar 'tshal// rjes su brtse bar nyer dgongs nas// gnang ba ru ni mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod do// gnyis pa bum pa lhag par gnas pa ni/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa 'am/ gnyis kyang rung ste/ kha brgyan mgul chings byas la/ chu gtsang ma dang*/ 'o ma dang*/ sbrang dang*/ bu ram bum sman dang bcas pas bkang*/ rnam rgyal bum pa dbus su bzhag la de'i khar thod pa bdud rtsis bkang la/ de'i steng du sin dhu ra'i me long bzhag gzhan rnams phyogs mtshams su bzhag de rnams la lha bskyed/ mchod pa dang bstod pa la sogs pa byas la/ lha rnams 'od du zhu bar bsams la gsol ba gdab bo// las bum du rta mgrin bskyed la/ bar chod kyi bgegs bsrung ba dang*/ las thams cad bsgrub pa'i gsol ba gdab bo// gsum pa sbyin bsreg sta gon ni/

cho ga gzhan nas bshad pa bzhin du long yod na bya'o// bzhi pa slob ma lhag par gnas pa la yol ba'i phyi rol du las kyi bum pas slob ma rnams la khrus byas la/ gral la bkod nas slob ma la bar chod byed pa'i bgegs la gtor ma btang nas/ maṇḍal phul la/ de nas slob ma rnams la 'di skad bshad de/ khyed rnams thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba 'dod pa shin tu bzang*/ sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i chos thams cad theg pa che chung gnyis dang*/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhir gsungs pa las/ thugs rje chen po 'di ni rgyud sde bzhi'i rtsa ba zhag bdun tsam gyis dngos grub thob par byed pa yin te/ bya spyod kyi rgyud dang mthun pa'i a mo gha pa sha'i rgyud dang*/ thugs rje chen po'i gzungs dang rtog pa rnams yin/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang mthun pa ni/ dpal pad ma cod pan gyi rgyud dang sgo drug pa rnams yin/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud ni/ pha bla na med pa pad ma rgyal po dang*/ ma bla na med pa dang mthun pa'i pad ma zab pa'i rgyud gsungs pa las/ 'di ni slob dpon chen po pad ma 'byung gnas kyis bha gha la'i phag mo la brgyud de shin tu zab pa yin pas/ dkyil 'khor 'dir 'jug pa la sngon du gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ yan lag bdun pa bya dgos pas mdun gyi nam mkhar/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la lus longs spyod thams cad 'bul la/ phyag 'tshal/ sdig pa bshags dge ba la rjes su yid rang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol gdab/ nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lam la brten nas/ bdag gi lus kyang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la 'bul/ bsod nams thams cad byang chub tu bsngo ba'i lad mo gyis/ phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang*// yi dam lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas// thams ca

da bdag la dgongs su gsol// 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas// tha ma da lta thug gi bar// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis// lus ngag yid gsum sgo nas ni// sdig pa dpag med bgyis pa dang*// bgyid du bstsal dang yid rang dang*// khyed kyi spyan sngar bshags pa bgyi// slan chad bdag ni mi bgyid do// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ 'phags pa nyan thos rang rgyal gyi// yan lag rnams kyang bzung bar bgyi// 'gro ba kun gyi dge ba la// bdag ni rjes su yid rang ngo*// bde gshegs chos sku la bzhugs pa// 'gro ba kun la phan slad du// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar ni// bdag ni rtag tu gsol ba 'debs// bde gshegs mdzad pa mthar phyin nas// mya ngan 'da' bar bzhed rnams la// bskal pa'i tha mar bzhugs par ni// bdag ni rtag tu gsol ba 'debs// bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba gang*// bgyis sam bgyid du bstsal ba gang*// rjes su yid rang thams cad ni// 'gro ba kun gyis thob par shog /spyan ras gzigs dbang thug rje'i bdag /bla mar bcas pa thams cad la// bdag gis lus 'di phul ba yis// theg pa dman la mi 'jug par// theg chen bla na med pa'i lam// zab cing rgya che bstan du gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod do// de nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ thun mong dang khyad par gnyis las/ thun mong pa ni thams cad kyis byed pa yin pas sngar thob la/ khyad par gyi skyabs su 'gro ba ni theg pa chen po'i gzhir gyur pas gal che ste/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos kyi sku chen po dang*/ theg pa chen po'i chos zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyir mi ldog pa rnams la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul yin la/ dus da nas bzung ste byang chub gyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ ched du bya ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub chen po thob par bya ba'i ched du skyabs su 'gro bar bya ba'i bsam pas lad mo gyis/

phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dus 'di nas bzung nas ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su 'chi'o// 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog mchog theg pa chen po'i chos zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog byang chub sems pa'i dge 'dun phyir mi ldog pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes lan gsum du brjod/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i bslab bya dang*/ phan yon rgya chen po mdo sde dang*/ rgyud sde rnams las gsungs pas/ da gzod rims kyis shes par gyis shig de ltar skyabs su song nas/ sems bskyed par byed pa gal che bas/ sems bskyed pa 'di ni bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par byed pa'i rgyu gzhan don dang byang chub kyi don 'dzin pa/ de nyid don du gnyer ba'i 'dun pa dang mtshungs ldan ni/ mtshan nyid yin la/ smon pa dang*/ 'jug pa'i rnam par dbye ba can 'di skye ba'i rgyu ni/ 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po dang*/ sdug bsngal ba'i sems can la skyob par byed pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ngo mtshar che snyam pa'i dad pa dang*/ bdag gis de lta bu'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du byang chub tu sems bskyed la/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang mthun par lam pha rol tu phyin pa rnams la bslab par bya ste/ sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*/ ma grol ba rnams grol ba dang*/ dbugs ma byung ba dbugs dbyung ba dang*/ yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bgyi'o/ snyam pas lad mo byed du bcug ste/ phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// sems can rnams kyi don slad du// byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed ltar// de bzhin bdag gi sems bskyed do// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// bsod nams ye shes byang chub lam// thabs dang shes rab goms pas bgrod// de bzhin bdag gis lam bgrod do// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// thams cad mkhyen par sangs rgyas nas// mkha' mnyam sems can don mdzad ltar// de bzhin bdag gi don bgyi'o// sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams grol bar bgyi// dbugs ma byung rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*/

'gro kun mya ngan 'das la dgod// kun kyang sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces lan gsum brjod do// 'di ni pha rol tu phyin pa nas gsungs pa dang mthun pa/ 'di yi bslab par bya ba dang*/ phan yon rgya chen po rnams kyang da gzod shes par byas te bslab par bya'o// da ni bya ba dang spyod pa dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang mthun par 'jug par bya ste/ dang por spyi bor rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom ste/ thugs ka nas 'od zer byung pas sgrib pa dag par bsam zhing yi ge brgya pa tshar re bzlas par bya'o// de nas rnal 'byor gyi rgyud las gsungs pa'i rigs lnga'i sdom pa yang bsgrag par bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi dam tshig dang sdom pa ni/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa byas nas/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ dge ba'i chos sdud dang*/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims rnams 'dzin pa yin la/ mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig ni/ rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba/ phyi rdzas kyi rdo rje dril bu dang*/ nang rtsa rlung dang*/ gsang ba bde ba dang stong pa'i dam tshig 'dzin cing*/ bla ma la sangs rgyas dang 'dra bar 'dzin pa yin la/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rin po che'i rigs kyi dam tshig ni/ nyin re bzhin du zang zing gi sbyin pa dang chos dang*/ skyabs kyi sbyin pa dang*/ byams pa chen po'i sbyin pa dus drug tu sbyin pa'o// 'od dpag med pa'i pad ma'i rigs kyi dam tshig ni phyi nyan thos kyi theg pa dang*/ nang pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa rnams ma 'dres par 'dzin pa rnams yin la/ don yod grub pa'i las kyi rigs kyi dam tshig ni/ nyin re bzhin du mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa dang*/ bza' ba dang*/ spyod lam gyi dam tshig la sogs pa rnams 'dzin pa yin la/ 'di rnams thams cad bsgrub par nus na ni/ myur du sangs rgyas thob pa yin la/

gal te thams cad bsgrub mi nus na yang*/ sangs rgyas kyi dam tshig la sogs pa gang bsrung nus pa rnams ni blangs nas bsrung*/ bsrung mi nus pa rnams kyang da gzod bdag gis ci nus kyis blangs nas bsrung snyam pa'i bsam pas lad mo gyis/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par gyis// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ sdom pa yis ni tshul khrims dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims rnams// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te bzung bar bgyi// nam du yang ni mi spang ngo*// dbang gong ma mi byed na de yan chad kyis chog go /dbang gong ma byed na gzhan dag kyang bzung bar bya ste/ rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi// rig chen rigs mchog chen po la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// zang zing chos dang mi 'jigs byams// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung pa// pad ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum// dam chos so sor bzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog bsdus pa la// sdom pa thams cad yang dag ldan// kun nas so sor bzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams grol bar bgyi// dbugs ma phyung rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*// 'gro kun mya ngan 'das la dgod// zhes bzung ngo*// de nas rang nyid lhar lhag par mos pa bya ste/

rang nyid spyan ras gzigs sku ma dog dkar po/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi 'og ma 'phreng ba/ g.yon gyi 'og ma pad ma 'dzin par bsgom la/ thugs kar yi ge hrī dkar po bsam ste/ 'od zer 'phros pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dag par bsams la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ 'di ltar bsgoms pas kyang lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag pa dang*/ bar chod kyi bgegs bsrung ba dang*/ dngos grub thob par bshad de/ pad ma rgyal po'i rgyud las/ oṃ ma ṇi pad med hūm̐/ rgya mtsho nang gi rin chen bzhin// lan gcig mos pas brjod pa na// sems can dmyal ba'i nad las thar// lan gnyis brjod pas yid dwags su// 'gro ba'i sgo yang 'gag par 'gyur// lan gsum dud 'gro'i sgo yang 'gag /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga spyod kyang*// 'di dang ma bral gtsang bar gnas// bza' dang btung ba longs spyod kyang*// 'di nyid dran nas nyes pa med// bdud kyi bar du gcod pa kun// sngags kyi rgyal po bgrangs pas zhi// zhes bya ba gsungs pas na/ so shing la sogs pa ma byas kyang rung*/ byed na dkyil 'khor gzhan nas bshad pa ltar/ so shing dri zhim po'i shing la sor bcu gnyis pa byas la/ so shing gis maṇḍal la/ oṃ badzra hā swā hā zhes rdo rje bzhad pa'i sngags kyis 'dor ste/ rtse mo nam mkhar bstan na des mchog gi dngos grub thob/ shar du zhi ba/ lhor rgyas pa/ nub tu dbang*/ byang du drag po/ 'og tu sa 'og gi dngos grub/ mtshams su thun mong gi dngos grub thob par bshad do// de nas skyor chu ni/ las kyi bum pa'i chu'am/ dri bzang po'i chu khyor bar blugs te/ oṃ hrī bhi shud dha sarba dharmā sarba pa paṃ ni tsa ya saṃ shu dha ya bhi kal pa/ a pa ne ya hūm̐ zhes rdo rje sbyong ba'i sngags 'dis blud na ngag gi sgrib pa sbyong ba'o// bsrung skud gdags pa ni/

bsrung skud dmar po gsum bsgril la/ snying po'am rta mgrin gyi sngags kyis mdud pa byas la/ skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon/ bud med kyi g.yas la gdags te/ oṃ bhud dha me tri rakṣa rakṣa sarba du swā hā/ zhes rdo rje bsrung ba'i sngags kyis bsrung ngo*// ku sha'i chun po che chung gnyis la yi ge dhiḥbyin gyis brlabs la/ lag pa g.yas g.yon du byin te/ oṃ badzra tikṣ+ṇa baṃ zhes rdo rje rnon po'i sngags kyis sngas dang stan du byin la/ rmi lam gyi ltas bzang ngan mthong bar 'gyur ro// de nas zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos bshad pa ni/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud las gsungs pas/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams// u dum 'bar ba'i me tog bzhin// rgya lam na ni re 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung srid// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung pa// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gnyis med zab mo'i spyod tshul 'dis// sems can sangs rgyas 'grub par 'gyur// skal pa bye ba du ma ru// sngon du byas pa'i sdig pa gang*// de kun byang bar 'gyur ba ni// zab mo'i dkyil 'khor mthong bas so// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i// tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos// skyob pa gsang sngags bzlas nas ni// go 'phang bla na med par 'gro// yang dag spyod pa'i mchog 'di la// blo gros brtan po mi g.yo na// de dag gi ni ngan 'gro'i rgyu// sdug bsngal kun 'byung rab tu bcad// bdag nyid chen po khyed kyis ni// rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas la/ dbang thob 'bras bu skyes bzhin par// des na khyed rnams theg chen la// sa ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur// theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// lam 'dir khyed rnams 'gro ba las// rang byung skal pa chen po pa// 'jig rten kun gyis 'dren pa'i gnas// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur// zhes bya ba'i don cung zad bshad de/

tshogs dang gtor ma ci rigs pa byas la nyal te/ rmi lam bzang po la dngos grub 'thob ces lung bstan/ ngan na bzlog pa'i cho ga bya'o// slob ma lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga'o// dngos gzhi la gnyis te/ dang po ni maṇḍal legs par byas te thig gdab/ dbus su pad ma 'dab brgyad phyogs mtshon/ sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa/ rdo rje me ri dang bcas pa bri'o// de'i dbus su bum pa'i steng du thod pa'i khar sin dhu ra'i maṇḍal bzhag shar du rdo rje/ lhor bgrang 'phreng*/ nub tu yi ge drug ma'i glegs bam/ byang du mar me bzhag mchod pa rnams kyis bskor/ gtor ma bshams par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub mchod/ bdag 'jug dbang bskur dngos dang gsum las// dang po ni/ bdag nyid bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgoms la/ bdud rtsi byin gyis brlab pa byas la/ dkyil 'khor du bsang gtor bya ste/ stong pa'i ngang las dkyil 'khor gzhan yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gtso bo spyan ras gzigs/ shar du mi bskyod pa/ lhor rin chen byung ldan/ nub tu 'od dpag med/ byang du don yod grub pa'i rigs kyi spyan ras gzigs rnams bskyed la/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dgug gzhug bya/ phyi nang gi mchod pa dang bstod pa byas la/ bzlas pa cung zad byas te brtan par bya'o// bdag 'jug ni slob dpon rang nyid kyis maṇḍal phul la cho ga rgyas bsdus ci rigs pas dbang rnams blangs la bden pa brjod par bya'o// dbang bskur ba dngos gzhi la khrus byas shing gtor ma btang ste/ gdong bcings la maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bdag ni 'khor ba'i chos la skyo ba skyes// 'jig rten bya ba thams cad spangs nas ni// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog dam pa 'dir// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes lan gsum du brjod do// dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gsal bar bsgoms la/

sgo bzhi nas/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ zhes brjod la/ phyag byed du bcug de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i drung du/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang*/ sdom pa blangs nas bsrung snyam pa'i bsam pa byed du gzhug de nas lha'i lhag par mos pa bya ste/ slob ma rnams thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas na 'phreng ba/ g.yon pa pad ma bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan par bsgom du bcug de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par a dmar po/ snying khar hūm̐ sngon po/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs su byin gyis brlab/ de nas sngags kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor du sems bskyed par byas te/ rang nyid yi dam lha'i thugs kar/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo/ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa bsgom du bcug la/ rdo rje snying khar bzung ste/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsi ta/ u pa ta ya/ su ra ti sa ma ya staṃ ho/ sid dhaṃ badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod do// de nas dam tshig bsgrag par bya ste/ dang por dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i dam tshig ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ khyod ni rnal 'byor rigs su skyes// nga yis ye shes rdo rje sbyin// byin pas dngos grub thob par 'gyur// gang zhig 'di 'dra ma mthong ba'i// drung du smra bar ma byed cig /bag med smras na nyams par 'gyur// des na nga rgyal bcom nas ni// bdag nyid ma 'khrul shes par gyis// zhes brjod do// de nas dam tshig gi chu sbyin pa ni/ bdud rtsi'i chu blud cing*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig chu// dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ sarba pan tsa a mṛ ta ud ga ta hūm̐/ zhes brjod do// de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dam tshig ni/

deng 'di nas ni bu khyod kyi// rdo rje 'dzin pa nga yin gyi// nga yis ji ltar bka' stsal pa// khyod kyis skyo ba med par bsgrubs// gang yang nga la ma gus min// de bzhin gus par ma byas na// bdud kyis bcom nas ngan 'gror 'gro// de bas dam tshig gnas par gyis// zhes brjod la/ don yang ci rigs par bshad par bya'o// 'di rnams 'jug pa'i sngon du 'gro ba'o// dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa la gnyis las/ dang po ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin bsgom/ gsol ba gdab/ ye shes gzhug cing rdo rje'i glu blang ba las/ dang po ting nge 'dzin ni/ rang nyid rgyal ba rgya mtshor bsgoms pa'i lus kyi nang stong sang nge ba'i lte bar pad ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i steng du/ g.yung drung dmar po g.yon du 'khyil ba re/ de'i steng du sngags kyis bskor bar bsgoms pa las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la phog cing*/ 'od zer tshur 'dus/ lte ba'i hri la thim pas lus sems thams cad bde bas khyab par bsams la/ ngag tu gsol ba gdab pa ni/ jo bo thugs rje chen po skal pa bzang po'i sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ slob dpon pad ma grub thob brgyud pa'i tshogs dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ dpal rta mgrin dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ dam can chos skyong bsrungs ma dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong ba'i bsrungs ma dang bcas pa char ltar 'bab par bsams te/ sngags kyi rjes su/ a be sha ya/ a be sha ya a a zhes brjod cing*/

gu gul dang spos kyis bdug ste/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas byin brlabs kyang rtags ma byung gi bar du bya'o// rdo rje'i glu blang ba ni/ ltos cig rang gi sems la ltos// sems nyid cir yang grub pa med// grub pa med pa'i sems nyid la// sna tshogs snang ba ngo mtshar che// snang tsam nyid la sems su 'dus// sems can kun gyi sems nyid de/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes yin// rnam par mi rtog bsam mi khyab// gsal ba de yi ngo bor snang*// mos pa du ma'i sems can la/ thabs rnams sna tshogs bstan pa ste// sna tshogs sgyu ma'i sbyor ba yis// dpa' bo seng ge bzhin du spyod// bsam gyis mi khyab go 'phang 'thob// spyan ras gzigs kyi byin brlabs yin// bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa 'di// sna tshogs nor bu ji bzhin du// skal ldan rnams kyi spyod yul yin/ zhes brjod do// gnyis pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni/ snang ba brtag me tog dor/ dkyil 'khor bstan pa las/ dang po ni/ mig dar 'og tu bltas pas/ kha dog ni zhi ba la dkar/ rgyas pa la ser/ dbang la dmar/ drag po la nag po/ kha dog sna tshogs pa la las sna tshogs 'grub ces bstan to// me tog dor ba ni/ bde gshegs snying po'i dkyil 'khor du// rig pa'i me tog 'di dor bas// sngon tshe gang la sbyang pa'i lha// gang yin de la phog par shog /pra ti dza badzra ho/ zhes brjod nas me tog dor la/ rigs gang yin pa'i spyan ras gzigs thim par bsams la me tog mgo bor bzhag cing pra ti ghri hna i maṃ ba la ma hā swa twa zhes rigs so so'i ming gdags pa la/ dpal dgyes pa'i pad ma/ dpal pad ma mdzes pa/ dpal pad ma dgyes pa/ dpal pad ma brjid pa/ dpal pad ma'i dbang phyug ces gdags so// de nas mig dbye ba ni/ spyan ras gzigs dbang deng khyod kyis// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ dzñā na tsakṣu bi sho dha ya swāhā/

zhes brjod cing*/ dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni/ dkyil 'khor snying po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs// 'gro ba phun tshogs dngos grub kun// thams cad 'di las 'byung bas na// dngos grub thob phyir dam tshig bskyongs// gsang sngags la yang brtson par gyis// zhes brjod la chos bshad do// rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bris pa dpe yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'i gzhal yas khang pa na rigs lnga rnam par dag pa'i spyan ras gzigs/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ 'di lta bu bsgoms pa la brten nas sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu thob pa yin pas/ bskyed pa'i rim pa la brtson par gyis shig zhes brjod do// de nas dbang bskur ba dngos gzhi la gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ bum pa'i dbang dang*/ gsang ba'i dbang dang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang*// dbang bzhi pa rjes gnang dang bcas pa'o// dang po maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ pad ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor du// mgon po gzi brjid 'od dpag med// rgyal sras tshogs dang bcas pa la// dbang bskur yongs su rdzogs pa ltar// de bzhin bla ma khyed kyis kyang*// bdag la dbang bskur mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod de gsol ba gdab bo// de nas thog mar bum pa'i dbang bskur ba ni/ slob ma rnams thugs rje chen por bsgom du bcug la/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bum pa'i dbang bskur te/ nyon mongs pa gti mug dag /gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi dbang thob par bsgoms la/ spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// sangs rgyas rnams kyi bum pa'i dbang*// rgyal sras rnams la bskur ba ltar// deng 'dir khyod la bskur bar bya// chos dbyings ye shes dbang 'di khyod kyi long*// sku mchog bum pa'i dbang 'di yongs rdzogs shog

/oṃ ā hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ bhuddha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes brjod la dbang bskur zhing*/ bum chus khrus bya'o// de nas mi bskyod pa'i rdo rje'i dbang ni/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rdo rje lag tu byin la/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang rnam par dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi dbang thob par bsam ste/ mi bskyod rgyal po rigs kyi gtso// zhe sdang rnam dag rdo rje'i dbang*// deng 'dir khyod la bskur bar bya// me long ye shes dbang 'di yongs rdzogs shog /oṃ ā hūm̐ hrī/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ badzra sa twa a bhi ṣiñtsa a/ de nas 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo glegs bam gyi dbang ni/ yi ge drug pa'i po ti lag tu byin la/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dag 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi dbang thob par bsams te// pad ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor du// 'dod chags rnam par dag pa yi// sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsung mchog dbang*// deng 'dir khyod la bskur bar bya// so sor rtog pa'i dbang 'di khyod kyis long*/ oṃ a hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ pad ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī/ de nas rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ngo bo 'phreng ba'am/ dbu rgyan gyi dbang mgo thog tu bzhag nas/ nyon mongs pa nga rgyal rang sar dag tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur*/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi dbang thob par bsam/ rin chen mchog gi dkyil 'khor du// nga rgyal rang sar dag pa yi// sangs rgyas rnams kyi yon tan dbang*// deng 'dir khyod la bskur bar bya// mnyam nyid ye shes dbang de khyod kyis long*// oṃ ā hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad med hūm̐: oṃ ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa traṃ/ de nas don yod grub pa'i ngo bor mar me'am dril bu lag tu byin la/ nyon mongs pa phrag dog rang sar dag 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/

bya ba grub pa'i ye shes la dbang thob par bsgoms la/ 'phrin las yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor du// phrag dog rang sar dag pa yi// sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'phrin las dbang*// deng 'dir khyod la bskur bar bya// bya grub ye shes dbang 'di yongs rdzogs shog /oṃ ā hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐ oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa a/ de nas rang nyid rigs drug pa sangs rgyas rnams kyi rdo rje lag tu byin nas/ ye shes lnga dang ldan par bsgoms nas/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// khyed kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs bstan// oṃ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi badzra sa ma ya staṃ/ e sha dha ra ya mi hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas dbang bskur te/ nyon mongs pa lnga dag phung po lnga gnas gyur/ ye shes lnga'i spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bsgom pa la dbang ba yin no// de nas gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba ni/ maṇḍal phul gsol ba btab nas/ rang gi lus phung po khams dang skye mched spyan ras gzigs kyi dkyil 'khor du shes par bya ste/ thugs rje chen po dang gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro gnyis su med pa'i byang chub kyi sems su mos par byas la/ ka pa la'i bdud rtsi lce la bzhag la/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thod pa'i dbang*// sangs rgyas rnams kyis rab bsgrubs pa// deng 'dir khyod la bskur bar bya// gsang mchog thod pa'i dbang 'di khyod kyis long*// oṃ ā hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ oṃ dhu ma gha ye na ma swā hā/ ha ri ni sa ra dza hri ya hūm̐ dza a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes brjod la dbang bskur ro/ 'di ni dkyil 'khor ni lus kyi dkyil 'khor la brten/ bskur ba'i gnas ni ngag la bskur sgrib pa ni ngag gi sgrib pa 'dag rlung rdo rje'i bzlas pa bsgom pa la dbang thob par bya'o// de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba ni/

maṇḍal phul gsol ba btab nas/ sin dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mar bskyed la/ slo ma rnams thugs rje chen por bsgoms la/ gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma mar me la me 'phros pa lta bur slob ma'i snying khar bstims te/ dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsams te/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi me long dbang*// sangs rgyas rnams kyis rab bsgrubs pa// deng 'dir khyod la bskur bar bya// shes rab ye shes dbang 'di khyod kyis long*// oṃ ā hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ oṃ dhu ma gha ye na ma swā hā/ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya hūm̐ dza a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ zhes brjod la/ sin dhu ra'i thig le snying khar byugs la dbang bskur/ dbang bskur ba 'di ni sin dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas sems la dbang bskur/ sems kyi dri ma dag gdams ngag ni byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa la dbang par byas par 'gyur ro// de nas dbang bzhi pa ni/ bla mas tshig gi brda' sprad par bya ste/ lus lha/ ngag sngags/ sems chos nyid/ snang ba thams cad gzhal yas kyi khang pa/ sems can thams cad thugs rje chen po la sogs pa'i lha'i rang bzhin du shes pas chos thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma bzhin du bsgom pa ni/ dbang bzhi pa'i don yin no// 'di rnams kyi don yang rgyud las gsung pa/ bum pa'i dbang ni dang po ste/ gsang ba'i dbang ni gnyis pa'o// shes rab bskyed pa gsum pa ste// nges shes bskyed pa bzhi pa yin// lha dang sngags dang stong pa nyid// bde stong 'brel bar bsgoms pa dbang*// tha mal lus kyi rnam rtog ni// dang po bum pa'i dbang gis bcad// rang gzhan lha yi rnam par bsgom// tha mal ngag gi rnam rtog ni// gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang gis bcad// bzlas brjod rgyun du bzlas pa'o// tha mal sems kyi rnam rtog ni/ gsum pa shes rab dbang gis bcad// bde dang stong ba'i don dran bya// 'bras bu thams cad bsdus pa ni// bzhi pa ye shes dbang yin no// rang gzhan lha ru gsal ba dang*// nga rgyal phra ba tsam zhig bsgom// zhes gsungs so// 'di rnams ni dbang gi dngos gzhi'o// da ni rjes su gnang ba la gnyis las/

dang po rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen pos sems can gyi don byed par mos pa byas la/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// sems can la ni phan pa'i phyir// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul gyur pa// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// ces pa dang*/ de bzhin du mi bskyod pa'i rdo rje dang*/ rin chen 'byung ldan kyi nor bu dang*/ 'od dpag med kyi pad ma dang*/ don yon grub pa'i rgya gram gyi 'khor los sems can gyi don bya'o// gnyis pa sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang ni/ dus thams cad du bla ma spyi bor bsgom pa dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku'i 'phrin las bsgrub par gyis shig spyi bor sin dhu ra'i thig le bya'o// de nas 'phreng ba lag tu byin la/ sngags kyi rjes gnang byin te/ da phyin chad sngags bzlas pa la brtson pa dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsung gi 'phrin las sgrubs par gyis shig thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba ni/ deng nas bzung ste sems can rnams la snying rje chen po bskyed de/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs kyi 'phrin las bsgrub par bya'o// de nas lung bstan pa ni/ de ring ngas khyod lung bstan te// 'od dpag med pa'i de bzhin gshegs// srid pa shin du dag pas na// srid pa'i sdug bsngal kun las grol// oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta sid dhi sa ma ya staṃ bhur bhu ba swā hā/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na rigs kyi gsang mtshan dang mthun pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur ro// da phyin chad khyed rnams kyis spyan ras gzigs kyi sgo nas 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po sgrubs shig ces brjod do// rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga'o// de nas yon dbul/ tshogs dang gtor ma btang*/ dga' ston byas la/ dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol/ bkra shis dang bsngo ba bya'o// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang gi cho ga dri med don bsdus zhes bya ba rang byung rdo rjes sbyar ba rdzogs so// khyi lo zla ba lnga pa la pho brang chen po nas bod du byon pa'i dus su slob ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis zhus pa'i ngor mdzad pa/

bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog/ ༈ //rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang chog bzhugs// bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje'i mnga' bdag nyid// snyigs ma'i dus 'dir 'gro ba'i dpal gyur brtse ba can// bya spyod rnal 'byor de bzhin ston pa po// ci lta ji snyed mkhyen bzhin 'gro kun dpal mchog mkhyen la bstod// thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgo nas gzhan don du slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi cho ga dang gsum las/ sngon du 'gro ba la rnam pa lnga ste/ sa'i cho ga nas mchod pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i bar dang gcig las rgyu 'bras kyi chos bshad cing mi dge ba las bzlog par bya ba dang gnyis/ skyabs su 'gro ba khyad par can 'bogs pa dang gsum/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas las bzlog pa dang bzhi/ bla ma dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs pa dang lnga'o// dang po sa'i cho ga la/ sa brtag pa dang*/ sa sbyang ba la sogs te sa'i cho ga rnams 'khor lo bde mchog la sogs pa gzhan nas bshad pa ltar rgyas par bya'o// de nas dkyil 'khor bri ba ni thig legs par gdab cing*/ sa tshon rnams rin po che'i snod du blugs te legs par bkod pa la hrī ha ri ni sa ces pa bris la/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor du bskyed la/ mchod pa dang bstod pa yang ci rigs pa 'bul bar bya'o// de nas tshon 'gyed par bya ste/ dbus zlum bskor chos 'byung dang bcas pa bri zhing pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i phyogs bzhi dmar po bya/ shar lho sngon po/ lho nub ser po/ nub byang dmar po/ byang shar lhang khu/ mu khyud nag po/ sgo bzhi pa me ri rdo rje dang bcas pa bri bar bya'o// de nas bca' gzhi rdzas kyi rim pa ni/

bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa cig la kha rgyan mgul chings dang bcas pa dbus su bzhag cing*/ yang ka pa la mtshan nyid dang ldan pa cig dri bzang po dang ldan pa'i btung bas bkang*/ de'i steng du me long gtsang ma cig la dri bsang dang bdud rtsi byugs la/ sin dhu ra legs par bkod cing g.yon bskor du chos 'byung bris te/ dbus su hri bri/ de'i mthar snying po bri bar bya'o// oṃ ā hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ oṃ badzra bha ra hi/ sarba bhud dha ḍa ki ni ye/ badzra warna ni ye/ badzra bhe ro tsa ni ye/ ha ri ni sa zhes pa bri/ bum pa'i rdzas bstan pa ni/ lnga tsho drug dang*/ gsum tsho gnyis dang*/ dgu tsho cig go /de nas maṇa 'ji bzhi'i steng du/ shar du rdo rje/ lhor bgrang 'phreng*/ nub tu glegs baṃ/ byang du mar me bzhag par bya'o// de nas mtha' ma mchod pa ci 'byor gyis bskor bar bya'o// de nas las kyi bum pa cig la slob dpon gyis/ yi dam lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas bzlas pa byas la/ las kyi slob dpon gyis bum pa de gdan drangs te/ slob ma rnams la khrus bya zhing yar bos te yol ba'i phyi rol du bzhag par bya'o// de nas slob dpon la gsol ba 'di ltar gdab ste/ bdag nyid 'khor ba'i chos la skyo ba skyes// 'jig rten bya ba thams cad spangs nas su// rnam par thar pa'i grong mchog dam pa ru// dam pa bdag ni nges par gzhug tu gsol// zhes brjod de gsol ba gdab cing de nas slob dpon gyis/ slob ma rnams la 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgyud la dran cing mi rtag pa thob par bya ba'i ched du/ las rgyu 'bras rigs drug gi sdug bsngal/ theg pa'i yon tan mthong ba'i ched du ci rigs pa bshad par bya'o// gsum pa ni lam log pa las khyad par du bya ba'i ched du thun mong gi skyabs 'gro ni/ so so thar pa'i rigs bdun gang rung la dgod par bya/ nyan thos las khyad par gyi skyabs su 'gro ba sbyin par bya'o// de nas theg pa chen po la dgod par bya ba'i don du/

byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa sbyin pa ni/ smon 'jug gi cho ga gzhan nas 'byung ba rgyas par bshad pa ltar grub na legs/ ma grub na thun mong dang khyad par sems bskyed bsdus pa tsam byas pa'i rjes la/ gsang sngags rgyud sde'i lam la 'jug par bya ste de yang spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rgyud sde bzhi la 'jug par byed pa la/ bya ba'i rgyud dang spyod pa'i rgyud gnyis ka mthun pa a mo gha pa sha dang/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang mthun pa pad ma cod pan la sogs pa'i sgor 'jug par byed pa'am/ yang na rgyud sde spyi'i lha gang yang rung pa re re'i mngon par rtogs pa tsam bstan pa ni/ theg pa'i rim 'jug zhes bya ste/ gong ma rnams kyi phyag len gyi bzhed par 'dug la/ 'di la ni khyad par gyi chos drug dag ldan pa yin pa las/ dbang dang tha dad med pa'i byin brlabs su 'gyur zhing*/ rgyas par ni dbang chen mo'i nang du shes par bya'o// de nyid kyi rim pa ltar na sngon 'gro'i chos bdun du gnas pa las rgyud sde rim 'jug gsum po ni/ thub dbang sgo drug pa'i rgyud ltar gsol ba 'debs pa'i rim pa ltar sbyar te/ sems bskyed phan chod thon pa'i rjes de nas/ bla ma la gsol ba btab pa ni 'di skad brjod do// bdag gi skye ba thog med nas// da lta'i lus 'di blangs pa'i bar// mi dge bcu yi las dbang gis// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor yang yang 'khor// sdug bsngal mang po rang gis myong gyur kyang*// de la yid ni 'byung bar ma gyur pas// da rung sdug bsngal nyid la mngon par zhen// da ni dad pa chen po la// snying rje khyad du 'phags pa yis// rtog pa thams cad bsdus nas ni// bsam pa bzang pos nyan par 'tshal// rdo rje bla ma sangs rgyas dang*// gnyis su med pa khyod gson cig /gti mug rnam par dag pa dang*// gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur nas// chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes su// bla mas bdag ni drang du gsol// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bgyi// nga rgyal rnam par dag pa dang*// tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur nas// mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes su// bla mas bdag ni drang du gsol// sbyin pa rnam bzhi sbyin pa dang*// mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba btab// 'dod chags rnam par dag pa dang*/

'du shes phung po gnas gyur nas// so sor rtog pa'i ye shes su// bla mas bdag ni drang du gsol// bzlas brjod mang po bdag bgyi'o// phrag dog rnam par dag pa dang*// 'du byed phung po gnas gyur nas/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes su// bla mas bdag ni drang du gsol// mchod pa'i las rnams ci nus bgyi// zhe sdang rnam par dag pa dang*// rnam shes phung po gnas gyur nas// me long lta bu'i ye shes su// bla mas bdag ni drang du gsol// bla ma dang ni yi dam lha// yud tsam brjed par mi bya'o// nyon mongs ma lus dag pa dang*// phung po lngar bcas gnas gyur pa'i// ye shes lnga yi dkyil 'khor du// bla mas bdag ni drang du gsol/ byams dang snying rje dus rtag tu// 'gro ba rjes su bzung bar bgyi// zhes bla ma la gsol ba gdab bo// da ni rigs lnga la gsol ba gdab pa ni// rang nyid 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po chen por bsams te/ lag par gser kyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan par bsgom nas 'di skad brjod do// nga ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs// sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad la// kun nas dad pas skyabs su mchi// bsod nams tshogs dang ye shes tshogs// dam pa gnyis ni bsags pa dang*// nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa yi// mun pa thams cad gsal ba dang*// lam gyi bar chad zhi ba dang*// 'bras bu sku bzhi thob pa dang*// brtson 'grus gsum la 'bad pa dang*// gzugs kyi phung po rnam par dag /gti mug chos dbyings ye shes te// snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sku// sangs rgyas sku yi ngo bo nyid// thugs rje chen pos bdag bzung la// nges par khyed dang gnyis med pa'i// bde ba chen po'i grong mchog tu// dkar la dri ma med pa yi// sku dang tha mi dad par mdzod// zhe lan bdun bskyar la gsol ba btab/ lha de rang la bstim mo/ rang gi 'od kyis 'jig rten gyi khams snang bar bsam mo// rang nyid sa la bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po lag na pad ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa bsnams par bsams la/

'di skad ces gsol ba gdab bo// nga ni pad ma'i rigs mchog ste// sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas la// kun nas dang bas skyabs su mchi// bsod nams tshogs dang ye shes tshogs// dam pa gnyis ni bsags pa dang*// nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa yi// mun pa thams cad bsal ba dang*// lam gyi bar chad zhi ba dang*// 'bras bu sku bzhi thob pa yi// brtson 'grus gsum la 'bad par bya// 'du shes phung po rnam par dag /'dod chags sor rtog ye shes te// snang la rang bzhin med pa'i gsung*// sangs rgyas gsung gi ngo bo nyid// thugs rje chen pos bdag zungs la// nges par khyed dang gnyis med pa'i// bde ba chen po'i grong mchog tu// dmar la dri ma med pa yi// gsung dang tha mi dad par mdzod// zhes gsol ba sngar bzhin btab bo// lha de rang la bstim mo// rang gi 'od kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab par bsam mo// rang nyid rin chen mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog gser gyi mdangs dang ldan pa phyag na gser gyi pad ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan par bsams nas/ gsol ba 'di ltar btab/ nga ni yon tan rigs mchog ste// sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan la// kun nas dang pas skyabs su mchi// bsod nams tshogs dang ye shes tshogs/ dam pa gnyis ni bsags pa dang*// nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa yi// mun pa thams cad bsal ba dang*// lam gyi bar chad zhi ba dang*/ 'bras bu sku bzhi thob pa yi// brtson 'grus gsum la 'bad par bya// tshor ba'i phung po rnam par dag /nga rgyal mnyam nyid ye shes te// snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sku// sangs rgyas yon tan ngo bo nyid// thugs rje chen pos bdag zung la// nges par khyed dang gnyis med pa'i// bde ba chen po'i grong mchog tu// gser la dri ma med pa yi// sku dang tha mi dad par mdzod// zhes gsol ba btab pa dang*/ 'od kyis khyab par bsam pa yan chod gong gis 'gre'o// rang nyid cig pa'i khro bo sku mdog ljang sngon brjid par phyag tu ral gri bsnams par bsams la/

gsol ba 'di skad gdab bo// nga ni las kyi rigs mchog ste// sangs rgyas don yod grub pa la// kun nas dang pas skyabs su mchi// bsod nams tshogs dang ye shes tshogs// dam pa gnyis ni bsags pa dang*// nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa dang*/ mun pa thams cad bsal ba dang*// lam gyi bar chad bsal ba dang*// 'bras bu sku bzhi thob pa yi// brtson 'grus gsum la 'bad par bya/ 'du byed phung po rnam par dag /phrag dog bya grub ye shes te// snang la rang bzhin med pa yi// sangs rgyas 'phrin las ngo bo nyid// thugs rje chen pos bdag zungs la// nges par khyed dang gnyis med pa'i// bde ba chen po'i grong mchog tu// zar ma'i me tog 'dra ba yi// sku ni tha mi dad par mdzod// ces gsol ba btab pa dang 'od kyis khyab pa'i bar bsam pa sngar bzhin no// rang nyid dge slong chen po chos gos gsum 'chang ba/ rnyed pa spong ba/ phyag gnyis su u dum 'bar ba'i me tog mdzes pa 'dzin par bsam la/ 'di skad ces gsol btab par bya'o// nga ni rdo rje rigs mchog ste// sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' la// kun nas dang bas skyabs su mchi// bsod nams tshogs dang ye shes tshogs// dam pa gnyis ni bsags pa dang*// nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa yi// mun pa thams cad bsal ba dang*// lam gyi bar chad zhi ba dang*// 'bras bu sku bzhi thob pa yi// brtson 'grus gsum la 'bad par bya// rnam shes phung po gnas gyur nas// zhe sdang me long ye shes te// snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sku// sangs rgyas thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// nges par khyed dang gnyis med pa'i// bde ba chen po'i grong mchog tu// be ḍurya yi sangs rgyas dang*// sku dang tha mi dad par mdzod// ces gsol ba lan gsum gdab bo// lha de rang la thim par bsam mo// rang gi 'od zer mthing ga rang gi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bas khyab par byas par bsam mo// rang nyid tha mal par bsams te/

lag pa thal mo sbyar nas/ snyem pa 'bru lngas bkang bar bsams te/ gsol ba 'di skad ces gdab bo// nga ni theg pa chen po'i rigs// sangs rgyas 'jig rten dbang phyug la// kun nas dang bas skyabs su mchi// bsod nams tshogs dang ye shes tshogs// dam pa gnyis ni bsags pa dang*// nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa yi// mun pa thams cad bsal ba dang*// lam gyi bar chad zhi ba dang*// 'bras bu sku bzhi thob pa yi// brtson 'grus gsum la 'bad par bya// phung po lnga ni rnam dag pas// nyon mongs lnga po ye shes lnga// snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sku// sku mdog dkar po rnam par snang mdzad rigs// rin chen brgyad ni rin chen 'byung ldan rigs// thal sbyar rdo rje rtse lnga mi bskyod rigs// pad ma dkar po snang ba mtha' yas rigs// mu tig 'phreng ba don yod grub pa'i rigs/ sangs rgyas ma lus 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid// bcom ldan thugs rje chen po bdag zung la// nges par khyed dang gnyis su med pa yi// bde ba chen pa'i grong mchog dam pa ru// 'od lngas mdangs ston 'jig rten khyab par mdzad// gnyis su med pa'i gnas su drang bar mdzod// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab bo// kho rang la bstim mo// 'od lngas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab par bsam mo// oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ ces lan mang du skyar ro// de yan chad sngon du 'gro ba'i cho ga /las rgyu 'bras dang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gsol ba gdab pa dang bcas pa rnams yin/ da ni dngos gzhi ston te 'di'i dus su spyan 'gebs btang la/ de nas nang du khrid de gral du bsdod du gzhug cing*/ slob dpon gyis rta mgrin gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ gu gul dang tshil chen bsreg cing byin brlabs byas pa'i gsang gtor te bskrad la/ las kyi slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor mtha' ma bskor zhing*/ 'di ltar lha mo ya mtshan can// zhes bya ba la sogs pas mtshams bcad par bya'o// de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis slob ma'i spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste 'di ltar dam bsgrag go

/khyod ni rnal 'byor rigs su skyes// nga yis ye shes dam pa sbyin// byin pas dngos grub thob par 'gyur// gang zhig 'di rnams ma mthong ba'i// drung du smra bar ma byed cig /bag med smras na nyams par 'gyur// de bas nga rgyal bcom nas ni// bdag nyid ma 'khrul shes par gyis// zhes slob ma du yod pa la dam bsgrag go /de nas dam tshig gi chu blud pa ni// bdud rtsi lce'i steng du bzhag ste/ 'di ni dam tshig bdud rtsi'i chu// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub 'thob// dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed// 'thung cig dam tshig rdo rje'i chu// a mṛ ta swa ta hūm̐/ zhes brjod do// de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dam tshig ni/ deng 'di nas ni bu khyod kyi// rdo rje 'dzin pa nga yin gyis// nga yis ji ltar bka' stsal pa// khyod kyis skyo ba med par gyis// gang yang nga la ma gus min// de bzhin gus par ma byas na// bdud kyi bcom nas ngan 'gror 'gro// de bas dam tshig gnas par gyis// zhes brjod do// de'i mtshan nyid bshad par bya ste/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ces pa theg pa chen po spyod cing skal ba dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rigs su skyes pa'o// nga'i ye shes ces pa lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rtogs par byed pa'i thabs yin pas/ lam dam pa khyod la sbyin par bya'o// zhes bya ba yin pas de lta bu de byin nas yang dag pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur te/ de lta bu'i dngos grub kyi rgyud de/ nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ byis pa tha mal pa so so'i skye bo blo chung ba rnams kyi rtsar mi bshad do// de'ang tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya ba ni/ skal ldan rnams kyi gsol zas yin// skal med rnams kyi dug tu 'gyur// zhes bya ba dang mtshungs par 'di lta bu'i gsang sngags dam pa 'di thos nas skrag cing dngangs pa dang*/ bskur bar 'debs cing sdig pa'i rten du 'gyur ba dang*/

bdag nyid kyi dam tshig nyams par 'gyur bas/ bdag nyid kyi nga rgyal bcom ste/ zhi ba dang dul ba dang ldan pas/ bdag nyid ma 'khrul bar ci ltar gzhan gyi yid dang mthun par byed pa'o// dam tshig rdo rje'i chu zhes pa dper na mna' chu blud pa dang 'dra ste/ gzhan la smra bar ma byed cig /smras na nyams par 'gyur ro// zhes pa yin la/ dam tshig bla na med pa de bsrungs nas dngos grub 'thob par 'gyur ro// deng 'di nas ni zhes pas/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du/ gsang sngags kyi lam ston par byed pa rdo rje 'dzin pa nga yin gyis/ ci ltar zer ba myur du byed dgos so// de yang bla ma dag gi bka' byung na// yi ge nga'i rked pa chod ces pas/ yi ge nga ces pa las sla ba med pa la/ de'i bka' byung na phyed du zhog la bka' bsgrubs cig de ci'i phyir na/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las sgrol bar byed pa bla ma yin pas/ ma gus par cung zad kyang med pa gyis shig ma gus pa'i rnam pa cung zad byas na/ bdud kyis bcom nas ngan song gsum nas thon pa'i dus med par 'gro ba yin pas/ de bas dam tshig la gnas par gyis/ zhes pa'o// da ni slob ma rnams la spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mngon rtogs 'di lta bu yod par bya'o// snang zhing srid pa'i chos thams cad thog ma med pa'i dus nas/ rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi sku yin pa la/ sems can rnams kyis ngo ma shes nas/ 'khor bar 'khyams pa 'di rnams bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par bya'o// de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das jo bo thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i go 'phang thob par bya snyam du sems bskyed nas/ oṃ swa bha ba bi shud dho sarba dharma swa bha ba bi shud dho haṃ/ zhes brjod pas/

phyi snod kyi 'jig rten dang nang bcud kyi 'gro ba ma lus pa/ stong pa nyid du bsgom zhing*/ stong pa'i ngang las yi ge bhruṃ cig bsgom de yongs su gyur pa las/ gzhal yas khang gru bzhi'i sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs dang bcas pa de lta bur lam gyis bsgom pa ni/ dang por dbus su bzlum bskor gtso bo'i 'dom gang ba/ de'i nam mkha' la rdo rje rgya gram/ de'i mtha' mar rin po che'i gdung zlum po rgya gram gyis khong seng du zug par bsgom zhing*/ de'i mthar rdo rje'i gdung zlum po/ de'i mthar pad ma'i gdung zlum po/ de'i mthar 'khor lo gdung zlum po/ de'i mthar phyogs bzhir gyes pa rgya gram gyi gdung gru bzhi pa phyir la lhag pa/ rgya gram gyis mtshan pa bsgom mo// de lta bu ni thog gi dbyibs so// de ma yin pa pad ma'i gdung rkyang pa bsgoms kyang chog phyi'i dbyibs ni logs re re la gtso bo'i 'dom brgyad dang ldan pa dang po ye shes lnga'i brdar pan tsa re ga kha dog lnga dang ldan pa/ zhing du khru lnga dpangs su 'dom gsum dang ldan pa de'i steng du pha gu khru gang ba de'i steng du rin po che bai ḍurya'i snam bu 'dom phyed pa/ de'i steng du ba so'i gzeng khang khru gang ba la bar bar du/ rin po che'i pha gu tsi pa tra'i mgo dang ldan pa las rin po che re re'i dra ba dra phyed 'phyang ba/ de lta bu'i steng du gdung gi sna la rdo rje rgya gram gyis mtshan pa/ phyir la 'dom phyed lhag pa'i tshul gyis 'dod yon gyi snam bu dang mnyam pa de'i steng rdo kar ma shi sha las grub pa'i rtsa brgyad kyi rnam pa/ sgo bzhi blo bur gyi tshul du 'dug pa la/ rta babs cha bzhi mdzes pa'o// gtso bo'i tog gi nam mkha'i rdo rje rgya gram gyi steng du/ chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa bcu gsum dang ldan pa/ gdugs char kheb dar dpyangs kyis brgyan pa'o// rta babs re re'i steng du yang*/

chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa bcu gsum pa re re phyogs bzhi nas ri dwags bzhi bzhi ste de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug go /de ltar du gzhal yas khang bskyed nas/ da ni bdag bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa ni/ stong pa nyid kyi ngang las bdag nyid kyi rnam par shes pa yi ge hri gcig tu gyur par bsgom zhing*/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ dang po gnyis yum gyi rgyab tu thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi 'og ma na rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi 'og ma na me tog pad ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs dkyil mo dkrung du bzhugs pa/ sku la rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o// de lta bu'i yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ zhal gnyis ma spyan gsum khro gnyer dang ldan pa sku mdog mthun pa'i phag zhal tshangs bug tu byung pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod khrag rus pa'i rgyan cha lnga yis brgyan pa/ de lta bu'i phyogs bzhir spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rgyan cha lugs gtso bo dang mthun pa/ g.yas kyi 'og ma na bgrang 'phreng ngo*// ma ma ki ni phyag bzhi pa/ dang po gnyis yab kyi rgyab tu thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi 'og ma na rin po che/ g.yon pad ma'o// lha mo gzhan rnams kyang*/ thal mo sbyar ba mthun no// sangs rgyas spyan ni g.yas 'khor lo g.yon pad ma'o// na bza' dkar mo g.yas pad ma dkar po g.yon pad ma dmar po'o/ dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu g.yas ud pa la/ g.yon pad ma/ yum bzhi'i phyag mtshan no// mtshams bzhir rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*/ rin chen mkha' 'gro dang*/ pad ma mkha' 'gro dang*/ las kyi mkha' 'gro dang bzhi ni/ rdo rje rin po che dang*/ pad ma dang*/ ral gri'o// de mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'o// de'i mthar mchod pa'i lha mo lnga ni/ gzugs rdo rje/ sgra rdo rje/ dri rdo rje/ ro rdo rje/
