reg bya rdo rje rnams so// de lta bur gzhal yas khang sna tshogs dang bcas pa bskyed du bcug nas/ yan lag bdun pa/ spyan 'dren/ mchod bstod/ las kyi slob dpon gyis rgyas par bya'o// de nas gsol ba gdab par bya'o// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen pos bdag cag la bla na med pa'i ye shes dbab du gsol/ zhes pa lan gsum gsol ba gdab par bya'o// de nas ye shes dbab par bya ste/ slo ma rnams langs su bcug cing*/ spyi bor chos 'byung gi phyag rgya bcar bcug la ting nge 'dzin sbyong par byas te/ khyed rang thams cad rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsgom zhing bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ gsang sngags kyi lha tshogs thams cad kyi phyag g.yas na ḍa ma ru g.yon dril bu bsnams pa gar khyug khyug byed pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs shing byin gyis rlob par bsgom cig ces bya ste/ oṃ ā hūm̐/ oṃ ma ṇi pad med hūm̐/ sarba bhud dha ḍa ki ni ye/ badzra warna ni ye/ badzra bhe ro tsa ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badzra bha ra hi/ che ge mo a bhi sha hriṃ swāhā/ hriṃ hriṃ hriṃ/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ ces pa rnams bzlas shing dbab/ gu gul dang tshil chen bsreg cing lha cha yun ring du dkrol bar bya'o// de nas rjes la thams cad ye shes gnas pa'i bar du ye shes kyi glu blang ba ni/ ltos cig ltos cig rang gi sems la ltos// sems nyid cir yang grub pa med/ grub par med pa'i sems nyid la// sna tshogs snang ba ngo mtshar che// snang tsam nyid la sems su 'dus// sems can kun gyi sems nyid de// bde ba chen po'i ye shes yin// rnam par mi rtog bsam mi khyab// gsal ba de yi ngo bor snang*// rmongs pa du ma'i sems can la// thabs rnams sna tshogs bstan pa ste// sna tshogs sgyu ma'i sbyor ba yis// dpa' bo seng ge bzhin du spyod// bsam gyi mi khyab go 'phang 'thob// 'di spyan ras gzigs kyi byin brlabs yin// bla ma rgyud pa'i byin brlabs kyis// sna tshogs nor bu ci bzhin du// skal ldan rnams kyi spyod yul yin// zhes brjod do// de nas tshur khrid de dkyil 'khor bstan la/

ser po shas cher mthong na rgyas pa/ dmar po la dbang*/ dkar po la zhi ba/ nag po la drag po/ kha dog sna tshogs ni las sna tshogs pa la dbang ngo*// de nas me tog dor ba ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ 'di skad brjod do// bde gshegs snying po'i dkyil 'khor du// rig pa'i me tog 'di dor bas// sngon tshe gang la sbyang ba yi// gang yin de la phog par shog /de nas gtso bo yab yum la phog nas/ dpal dgyes pa'i pad ma/ dpal pad ma'i myu gu/ dpal pad ma mdzes pa/ dpal pad ma dgyes pa/ dpal pad ma brjid pa/ dpal pad ma'i dbang phyug ces gdags so// de nas spyan bkab bshus te/ spyan snga ma dag ngo bo dbyer med de// dbye dang mi dbye mtshan nyid gnyis med kyang*// srid zhu'i tshul gyis gser gyi thur ma yis// sna tshogs yangs pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas// spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid chos rnams kun// ci ltar mkhyen cing thams cad gzigs pa ltar// sangs rgyas ye shes spyan gyi dngos grub des// khyod dmus long lta bur gyur pa gsal bar shog /ces brjod do// da dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni 'di skad do// dkyil 'khor gnyan po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed// khyod ni rnal 'byor rigs su skyes// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ 'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dang*// dam tshig thams cad bskyangs pa dang*// gsang sngags 'di la brtson par gyis// byas la chos bshad do// de nas dbang bskur bar bya ste/ las kyi slob dpon gyis maṇḍal phul zhing gsol ba 'di skad ces gdab par bya'o// pad ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor du/ mgon po gzi brjid 'od dpag med// rgyal sras tshogs dang bcas pa la// dbang bskur yongs su rdzogs pa ltar// de bzhin bla ma khyed kyis kyang*// dbang bskur rdzogs par mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab bo// da ni rdo rje slob dpon gyis dbang bskur bar bya ste/

bum pa gdan drangs nas/ slob ma'i mgo thog tu bzhag ste/ ting nge 'dzin spyod pa ni/ bum pa 'di dang tha dad med par jo bo thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs bzhugs par bsam/ sku la 'od zer dkar po byung nas khyed rang gi lus la thim/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag bum pa'i dbang thob par bsgom/ dam tshig brjod pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten mgon// sangs rgyas rnams kyi bum pa'i dbang*// rgyal sras rnams la bskur ba ltar// do nub khyod la bskur bar bya// chos dbyings ye shes dbang 'di khyod kyis long*// oṃ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yi// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ ā hūm̐ hri/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ bhuddha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ de nas shar phyogs su rdo rje sems dpa'i dbang bskur ba ni/ rdo rje slob ma'i lag tu bzhag la/ ting nge 'dzin yod pa ni rdo rje 'di dang tha dad med par thugs mi bskyod pa rdo rje'i dbang thob par bsgom zhig bya/ hūṃ rdo rje mi bskyod rigs kyi gtso// zhe sdang rnam dag rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// me long lta bu'i dbang 'di khyod kyis longs// oṃ a hūṃ hrī/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ/ oṃ badzra swa twa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ nub sgor snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbang bskur te/ yi ge drug pa'i dbang blangs la/ slob ma'i lag tu bzhag la/ ting nge 'dzin yod pa ni/ dpe 'di dang tha dad med par/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byon nas khyed rang rnams la thim pas/ gsung mi bzad pa brgyan gyi 'khor lo'i dbang thob par bsgoms shig bya/ hūm̐ pad ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor du// 'dod chags rnam par dag pa yi// sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsung mchog dbang*// do nub khyod la bskur bar bya/ so sor kun rtog dbang ni khyod kyi long*// oṃ a hūm̐ hrī:

oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ oṃ pad ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī/ da ni dkyil 'khor gyi lho sgor yon tan gyi dbang bskur ba ni/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ngo bo bgrang phreng blangs te/ slob ma'i mgul du bskon la/ ting nge 'dzin yod pa ni/ phreng ba 'di dang tha dad med par rin chen 'byung ldan gyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byon nas/ khyed rang gi rgyud la thim pas/ nyon mongs pa'i nga rgyal dag nas/ rang byung ye shes kyi dbang thob par bsgom/ hūm̐ rin chen mchog gi dkyil 'khor du// nga rgyal rang sar dag pa yis// sangs rgyas rnams kyi yon tan dbang*// do nub khyod la bskur bar bya// mnyam nyid ye shes dbang 'di khyod kyis long*// oṃ ā hūm̐ hrī/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa traṃ/ da ni byang sgor don yod grub pas dbu rgyan par byas te/ mar me slob ma'i mgo thog tu bzhag la/ ting nge 'dzin spyod pa ni/ mar me 'di dang tha dad med par sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'phrin las don yod grub pa'i ngo bor byon nas/ khyed bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la thim pa tsam gyis shes bya'i sgrib pa dang 'du byed kyi sgrib pa dag nas/ 'phrin las bzhi'i dbang thob pa bsgoms shig hūm̐ 'phrin las ye shes yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor du// phrag dog rang sar dag pa'i dbang mchog 'di// do nub khyod la bskur bar bya// bya grub ye shes dbang 'di khyod kyis long*/ oṃ ā hūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ kar ma a bhi ṣiñtsa a/ de bzhin du rigs pa'i dbang bskur rdzogs par bya'o// de nas bum pa'i chus slob ma rnams la khrus bya'o// de nas slob ma rnams la bskyed rim gyis gdams ngag bstan/ dkyil 'khor ni rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bsten te/ dbang ni bum pa'i dbang bskur/ bskur ba'i gnas ni lus la bskur/ sgrib pa ni lus kyi sgrib pa dag gdams ngag ni bskyed rims ston/

bsgom pa ni lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom/ lta ba ni snang stong dbyer med du blta/ de goms 'dris mthar phyin pa yin na/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku 'thob/ de lta bu bsgom pa la dbang bar byas/ de'i mtshan nyid dang ldan par byas/ de'i skal ba dang ldan par byas so// de nas ngag dag par byed pa/ gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi lag tu thod pa thogs la 'di skad brjod do// sangs rgyas kun gyi thod pa'i dbang*// do nub khyod la bskur bar bya// thod pa'i dbang 'di khyod kyis long*// de nas yab yum gyi sngags dang*/ dbang gi sngags rnams brjod do// thod pa'i chang lan gsum blud/ de nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa gdams ngag ston/ dkyil 'khor ni bla ma yab yum gyi dkyil 'khor la bsten/ dbang ni ka pa la'i dbang bskur/ bskur ba'i gnas ni ngag la bskur/ sgrib pa ni ngag gi sgrib pa dag gdams ngag ni rnam par rtog pa shas che na rlung la slab pa'i gdams ngag ston/ bsgom pa ni gsal stong dbyer med du bsgom/ lta ba ni rig stong dbyer med du blta/ de goms 'dris mthar phyin na/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'thob/ de lta bu bsgom pa la dbang bar byas/ de'i mtshan nyid dang ldan par byas/ de'i skal ba dang ldan par bya'o// de nas yid dag par byed pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/ slob dpon gyis sin dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor lag tu thogs la/ 'di skad brjod do// sangs rgyas kun gyi me long dbang*// sangs rgyas kun gyis rab bsgrub phyir// do nub khyod la bskur bar bya// me long dbang 'di khyod kyis long*// ces pa'i sngags dang*/ dbang gi sngags lan gsum brjod do// dkyil 'khor ni sin dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten/ dbang ni sin dhu ra'i dbang bskur/ bskur ba'i gnas ni sems la bskur/ sgrib pa ni sems kyi sgrib pa dag /gdams ngag ni nyon mongs pa shas che na byang chub kyi sems la bslab pa'i gdams ngag ston/

bsgom pa ni bde gsal bsgom/ lta ba ni bde stong gnyis su med par lta/ de goms 'dris mthar phyin pa yin na/ 'bras bu chos sku 'thob/ de ltar bsgoms pa la dbang bar byas/ de'i mtshan nyid dang ldan par byas/ de'i skal ba dang ldan par byas// de nas tshig dbang ni/ slob dpon gyis me long bstan nas/ 'di skad brjod par bya'o// ltos shig ltos shig sems la ltos// sems nyid me long lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la dmigs su med// sems kyi dri ma dag pa'i phyir// gzugs brnyan lta bur shes par bya// zhes brjod la gdams ngag bstan pa ni/ sems kyi dbyings me long g.ya' dag pa lta bu yin/ de la nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pas sgribs pa ni/ thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor bris pa lta bu yin/ de la shes bya'i sgrib pa cha phra mo yod pa ni/ thugs rje chen po'i sngags bris pa lta bu yin/ de ltar du gang la yang gsal la ma 'gags pa rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa yin no/ dkyil 'khor ni snang srid kyi dkyil 'khor la brten/ dbang ni tshig dbang rin chen bskur/ bskur ba'i gnas ni lus ngag yid gsum spyi la bskur/ sgrib pa ni lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa dag gdams ngag ni ngo bo nyid kyi rim pa/ phyag rgya chen po'i gdams ngag ston/ bsgom pa ni rang gi sems spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa bsgom/ lta ba'i phyag rgya chen po blo las 'das pa la lta/ de goms 'dris mthar phyin pa yin na/ 'bras bu chos sku/ longs sku/ sprul sku gsum ngo bo dbyer med pas/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'thob pa'o// de nas sin dhu ra spyi bor byugs la/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las sgrol bar byed pa/ bka' brgyud kyi bla ma yin pas/ spyi bo'i gtsug tu mi 'bral bar bsgoms shig bya/ sin dhu ra'i sngags dang bcas pa spyi bor byugs/ me long gi ye shes slob ma rgyal ba rgya mtshor bskyed pa'i snying khar bstim la 'di skad brjod do// bu khyod kyi yi dam gyi lha rgyal ba rgya mtsho yin pas/

dus rtag tu snying khar yi dam gyi dkyil 'khor dang ma bral bar bsgoms shig ces brjod la/ lag pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gis slob ma'i snying khar byugs par bya'o// snying po'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ 'phreng ba lag tu gtad la/ snying po 'di'i lad mo byed du bcug go /oṃ ā hūm̐ hri/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ oṃ badzra bha ra hi/ sarba bhu dha ḍa ki ni yāe/ badzra warna ni ye/ badzra bhe ro tsa na ye/ ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan mang du brjod do// de ni rjes su gnang ba'o// de nas tshogs btab/ phud mchod bya/ gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa'o// de nas tshogs la longs spyad par bya'o// rjes kyi cho ga la/ lhag gtor btang ba dang*/ bkra shis dang*/ bshags pa dang*/ gshegs su gsol ba'o// bcom ldan 'das jo bo thugs rje chen po'i dbang bskur gyi cho ga rang byung rdo rjes sbyar ba rdzogs so// ༈ //rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang bskur dang tshogs mchod kyi lag len bzhugs// thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo// dbang bskur dang tshogs mchod kyi lag len 'di ltar bya'o// thog mar bgegs gtor btang*/ mtshams bcas yan lag bdun pa bya/ mngon rtogs bsgoms te/ de nas ye shes pa spyan drang ba ni/ hūm̐ lho nub srin po'i grong khyer nas// grub thob bye ba 'bum gyi dbus// slob dpon pad ma gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin brlabs mdzad du gsol// pad ma dbang gi zla gam nas/ mgon po tshe dbang 'od dpag med// spyan ras gzigs dbang gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin brlabs mdzad du gsol// mkha' spyod dag pa'i gzhal yas nas// mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum gyi dbus// yum cig mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin brlabs mdzad du gsol// me dpung 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// rta mchog rgyal po he ru ka /dpa' bo'i tshogs bcas gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin brlabs mdzad du gsol// dag pa sku yi zhal yas nas// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin brlabs mdzad du gsol// mi 'gyur thugs kyi gzhal yas nas// rdo rje ḍa ki gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin brlabs mdzad du gsol// pad ma gsung gi gzhal yas nas/

pad ma ḍa ki gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin brlabs mdzad du gsol// yon tan rgyas pa'i gzhal yas nas// rin chen ḍa ki gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin brlabs mdzad du gsol// 'phrin las grub pa'i gzhal yas nas// las kyi ḍa ki gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin brlabs mdzad du gsol// 'jig rten dur khrod gzhal yas nas// 'jig rten ḍa ki gshegs su gsol// 'phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub tu gsol// dam tshig chen po'i gzhal yas nas/ dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol// pho nya las mkhan mdzad du gsol/ ces ḍa ma ru dang dril bu dkrol zhing spyan drangs bar bya'o// rgyal ba rgya mtsho spyan ras gzigs// 'gro ba'i don du byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// ces bzhugs su gsol lo// chos dbyings mtha' dbus med pa la// nyi zla pad ma'i gdan steng du// ci bde bar yang bzhugs su gsol// oṃ pad ma ka ma la ye swā hā/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ pad ma mchog gi dkyil 'khor nas// pad ma mchog gi skur sprul pa/ gdug pa 'dul mdzad thod 'phreng la// gus pas yid kyis phyag 'tshal bstod// thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug sku// sku mdog dmar gsal 'jig rten dbang du bsdud// spyan gyi 'od zer 'gro la thugs rjes gzigs// zhal gyi 'dzum tshul thugs rjes kun la snyoms// shangs nas ye shes rlung gis nyon mongs 'thor// snyan nas thabs dang shes rab 'dul thabs mdzad// phyag gnyis dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med sbyor// g.yas pa bgrang 'phreng byang chub lam la 'dren// g.yon pa pad ma 'khor ba'i skyon dang bral// zhabs gnyis 'gro ba'i don la mnyam par bzhugs// rin chen rgyan drug pha rol phyin drug ldan// 'gro rnams ma lus thugs rjes dbang du bsdud// 'jig rten dbang phyug sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// dgyes pa'i 'dzab 'bul mchod par bzhes// dbang dang dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol// gsung gi dbang phyug snang ba mtha' yas sku// 'chi med tshe dbang mgon po 'od dpag med// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi gsung las sprul// bsgrub mchog bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// mi dmigs don gyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// phyi'i mchod pa yang*/

oṃ ā hūm̐ hri/ oṃ ma ṇi pad med hūm̐/ argaṃ zhes pa la sogs rje btsun ma'i mchod khrigs dang mthun no// dus gsum bde gshegs yum gcig ma// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag 'gro la gzigs// gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro ma// sku mdog dmar mo dbang gi tshul// tshad med bzhi yi 'gro don phyag /rnam rtog rtsad gcod gri gug g.yas// 'khor ba dbang bsdud thod 'phreng g.yon// skye shi rtsad gcod ral gri g.yas// dug gsum rtsad gcod kha ṭwāṃ g.yon// thabs dang shes rab brkyang bskum zhabs// 'dod yon rnam dag rus pa'i rgyan// gzhon tshul can la cung zad khro// thugs rje chags pas dbang bsdud ma// gang mthong dran pas ye shes bskyed// thugs rje'i spyan gyis bdag la skyobs// dbang dang dngos grub da lta gsol// rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma// rdo rje chos kyi dngos grub stsol// rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma// rin chen zas nor dngos grub stsol// pad ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma// chags pas dbang bsdud dngos grub gsol// las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma// dgra bgegs tshar gcod dngos grub stsol// mchog gi dngos grub bdag la stsol// gsang ba ye shes dngos grub stsol// chos dbyings lhun grub dngos grub stsol// phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub stsol// bhud dha ḍa ki ni/ badzra ḍā ki ni/ ratna ḍa ki ni/ pad ma ḍa ki ni/ kar ma ḍa ki ni/ sid dhi sid dhi zhes gsol ba gdab bo// nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ pad ma dbang gi lha tshogs la// dug lnga rnam par dag pa yi// rigs lnga dang ni ye shes sogs/ sha chen lnga yi mchod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol// 'byung ba lnga po rnam dag cing*// thabs dang shes rab dbyer med pa'i// zung 'jug bde ba chen po yi// kha dog yid 'ong reg byar ldan// zag med bde chen mchod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha yi bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// dbang bzhi bskur dang rgyud bzhi smin// thun mong mchog gi dngos grub stsol// ces nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba'i rim pa'o// thugs kyi lha mchog rta mgrin dbang gi lha// sku mdog dmar nag dregs pa dbang du bsdud// spyan gyi gzi mdangs 'gro la snying rjes gzigs// zhal gyi snying rje thugs rjes kun la snyoms// cung zad mche gtsigs skye shi rtsad nas gcod// dbu gtsug rta mgo gzhan gyi 'gran zla med// rta skad 'tsher bas khams gsum dbang du bsdud// dbang sdud phyag rgyas skye 'gro zil gyis gnon// pad ma'i phyag rgyas 'khor ba'i skyon ma gos// rin chen rgyan chas 'dod yon ma spangs dag

/zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum ye shes sems dpa'i tshul/ dbang chen rta mchog sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// sgrub pa po la dbang dang dngos grub stsol// zhes bstod do// pad ma dbang gi lha tshogs la// gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni// pad ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas// thabs dang shes rab dbyer med pa'i// yab yum bcu yi sbyor ba las// zag med bde ba chen po yi// ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol// pad ma rang byung me tog la// rag ta rang byung bde ba'i gnas// sha chen ga pur bdug spos dang*/ zhun chen snang gsal sgron me rnams// dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol// lhan skyes bde ba chen po yi// dga' ba bzhi dang bde ba brgyad// zag med nyams kyis rgyan pa rnams// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du// dpa' bo tshogs bcas rnal 'byor ma// gnyis med bde chen rol pa las// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i mchod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol// dbang bzhi bskur dang rgyud bzhi smin/ gsang ba bla med dngos grub stsol// ces so// hūm̐ 'gro ba kun la thugs rjes mnyam par gzigs// nyi ma'i 'od zer sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// chags rab don gyi 'gro ba dbang du bsdud// rdo rje phag mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// sngags kyi las mdzad mdzes pa ḍa ki'i tshul// rgya mtsho gling gi ḍa ki yi// las kyi mkha' 'gros byin rlabs char ltar 'bebs// rdo rje phra men sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// bstan pa'i ru 'dzin gdug pa'i dgra 'dul ma// ḍa ki bdud 'dul sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// rnal 'byor 'khor skyong byin brlabs char ltar 'bebs// ḍa ki zhi ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dkyil 'khor nas/ rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro la sogs pa'i// phyi nang ḍa ki rgya mtsho la// gus pa yid kyis phyag 'tshal bstod// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// pad ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas/

de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ chos sku skye 'gag med pa la// rang byung ye shes mchod par 'bul// dus gsum skye ba med pa la// snang ba sna tshogs mchod par 'bul// phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub stsol// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med cing*/ lhan skyes ye shes bde ba che// zag med bde chen mchod par 'bul// dbang bzhi rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs// dbyings dang ye shes ro mnyam zhing*// 'gag med ye shes lnga ldan zhing*// kun mkhyen ye shes mchod par 'bul// ngo bo nyid la dngos grub stsol/ ces de kho na nyid kyi mchod par 'bul lo// mi 'gyur bdud kyi sde bcom rdo rje'i rigs// rdo rje ḍa ki'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// re bskong bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs rin chen rigs// rin chen ḍa ki'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// chags pas thams cad dbang bsdud pad ma'i rigs// pad ma ḍa ki'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// don grub gdug pa 'dul mdzad las kyi rigs// las kyi ḍa ki'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// gdug pa 'dul mdzad rdo rje'i rigs su sprul/ rdo rje ging chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'dod pa'i don grub 'byung bar byed pa yi// rin chen ging chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// chags rab don gyis 'gro ba dbang du bsdud// pad ma ging chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// las kyi mtha' yis bstan pa'i ru tra 'dul// las kyi ging chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ dgongs pa lon pa'i pad ma 'byung gnas kyis// bdag dang mos pa'i gang zag la// byin brlabs chu bo'i gzhung bzhin phob// ces mchod bstod spel ba 'di nyid dam/ yang na mchod pa rnams phyogs gcig tu phul la/ bstod pa ci rigs par byas kyang chog go /de nas tshogs gzhung bzhin byin gyis brlabs la/ tshogs btab pa'i cho ga ni/ hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas// 'phrin las padma dbang gi lha// rnam 'phrul mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// dbang bskur byin brlabs mdzad du gsol// bde ba can gyi zhing khams na// mgon po tshe dbang 'od dpag med// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbus nas bzhengs// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes//
